hollow inhuman.origin: Who would take the name of Hollow as an Nuhumans. After his powers manifested, Hollow joined Lash's tribe. He returned to New York to capture Mark, who was now an ally of the New Warriors, and took Sun Girl along with Mark. Back in Jakarta, Sun Girl confronted Hollow about his intentions, who revealed he thought the Inhumans should reign above humanity. As he commanded his teammates to kill Sun Girl, she managed to break Haechi free, who used the fire created by Spark to empower himself and attack Hollow and the other enemies. Haechi used the distraction created by his escape to flee the scene along with Sun Girl. As Haechi was escaping, he encountered Lash. As both fought, with the New Warriors caught in the middle, Hollow presented Haechi as a gift for Lash. Lash considered a weakness that Hollow was following him because of fear, and killed him.

holly ann ember.name: Holly-Ann Ember
holly ann ember.first_appearance: Marvel Graphic Novel Vol 1 16: The Aladdin Effect
holly ann ember.origin: Holly-Ann Ember was a young girl living in Venture Ridge, Wyoming, who idolized superheroines and collected newspaper clippings of their exploits in a scrapbook. Her town was located near an AIM base that researched new energy sources. When they detected a powerful energy source in the town itself, their leader the Timekeeper sealed it off with an invisible barrier, and the town's population descended over two months into civil disorder and food shortages. Holly-Ann wished on her scrapbook for the superheroines she idolized to save her town, and unconsciously, her own mutant power teleported four of those superheroines - Wasp, She-Hulk, Storm, and Tigra - to her town. Discovering that Holly-Ann was the power source that AIM sought, the superheroines joined forces with some of the townsfolk to overthrow AIM and a giant robot under their control, and the town was freed. Storm gave Holly-Ann a card for Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters, should she wish to explore her powers, but it is unknown if she ever did contact the school.
powers: She proved capable of teleporting several people across the country without even being fully aware she was doing so. However, the full extent of Holly-Ann's power is unknown.

honcho vulturions.name: Honcho (Vulturions)
honcho vulturions.origin: Honcho was an engineer, but also sold heroin for money, which eventually got him arrested. He was imprisoned alongside Adrian Toomes and, feigning ignorance, he convinced the lonely old man to reveal the secrets of his costume. After being released on parole, he designed the four Vulturion costumes and their weapons. He also arranged most of their plans. === First Flight === While out on a scouting mission, Gripes observed Spider-Man fighting his costume, which had taken on a life of its own. Not wanting to take advantage of the hero while he was at a disadvantage, the other Vulturions joined Gripes in battle against the webhead. Despite being preoccupied, Spider-Man fought off three of the Vulturions easily and forced the fourth to fly into the church bell in order to weaken his alien costume. This last Vulturion dazed from being smashed into the bell gladly fled the church tower at Spider-Man's direction. Honcho revealed new blow dart weapons to the group, which they used successfully in robbing an armored car shipment. They next contacted the Kingpin and told him of their plans to kill Spider-Man, hoping that he would hire them as assassins. They ambushed Spider-Man in full view of the Kingpin's tower and the distraction agitated his wife, Vanessa, who was just beginning to recover from her psychological trauma. Coincidentally Spider-Man was carrying a birthday present for his Aunt May (a hat,) putting the hero at a severe disadvantage against his attackers since he could not allow it to be damaged. Regardless of this advantage the Vulturions were defeated one by one however they did manage nail the hero with several darts resulting in his loss of consciousness after the battle as the hat blew away. Kingpin was pleased with Spider-Man for ending the disturbance and restored/returned the hat good as new, the Vulturions earning the mobster's disdain. Adrian Toomes, having read the newspaper reports of the Vulturion's exploits, was furious over their usurping of his identity. Designing a new costume and breaking free from prison, Toomes located and attacked the four Vulturions. Though outnumbered, the Vulture's superior experience and determination won out and he began to whittle down the group. Planning to finish off each member in sequence after their defeat, Spider-Man decided to get involved. Despite taking another dart to the arm the hero webbed up the last of the Vulturions, passing out afterward leaving them at the mercy of the Vulture. The group is later seen in police custody. thumb|left|Honcho and his new team of Vulturions === Civil War === With his old crew gone Honcho found two new members for the Vulturions. Shortly after the group is hired by Senator Woodman, a Hydra agent, to steal Gamma-enhancement secrets from Baron von Blitzschlag. The Vulturions successfully stole the case from Blitzschlag, but an out of costume Peter Parker and the Scarlet Spiders soon caught up with and defeated the group.
powers: No known powers to speak of.
abilities: Engineer: Like the original Vulture, Honcho is a skilled engineer.

hooded haunt.name: Hooded Haunt
hooded haunt.origin: ===Preface=== Unlike Earth-616, Earth-98 does not operate on a Sliding Timescale and as such the passage of time and the details of events have progressed much slower. In this reality the Modern Age of Heroes (which is identified as the birth of the Fantastic Four occurred in the year 1961. Whereas the Earth-616 universe currently measures the Modern Age as being in existence for about fourteen years. When this reality was visited by the Thing of Earth-616, the modern age of his reality had existed for ten years, while the modern age of Earth-98 had existed for 37 years at that time. It should also be noted that while "year ten" on of the modern age of Earth-616 will always be moving forward in time, the year that Ben Grimm-616 visited this reality will always be the calendar year 1998. Events on this world appear to be more or less analogous to Earth-616, despite the differences, but the timeframe moves much slower. ===1998=== Virtually nothing is known about the Hooded Haunt, or his origins. By the year 1998 he was a member of the Frightful Four whose roster included the Wizard, Blastaar, and Quicksand at the time. In an attempt to gain access to the Fantastic Four's headquarters, the Wizard posed as a teenager named Ozzie and romanced Spike, daughter of the FF's Crystal. Due to Spike's rebellious nature she easily fell for "Ozzie" and was tricked into allowing him access. His attempts at infiltrating the Four Freedoms Plaza coincided with the appearance of the Thing of Earth-616 who exposed the Wizard's plot. The Wizard summoned the rest of the Frightful Four and a battle broke out between the villains and their foes the Fantastic Four. Ultimately the Fantastic Four's Zero Man used his powers to open a portal to the Negative Zone. Since Blastaar was seeking to return to his home dimension he allowed himself and his fellow teammates be sucked into the Negative Zone portal, ending the battle. The subsequent fate of the Frightful Four is unknown.
weapons: A scythe which could cause pain to souls.

hooded horror.name: Hooded Horror
hooded horror.origin: thumb|left|Hooded Horror unmasked The Hooded Horror was a Nazi military commander that was active during World War II. When the commander discovered the descendants of sea creatures that took over the small town of Valley Port the Horror realized that the legends were true and decided to use the creatures, called Lai-Sonians, to stage an invasion of the United States of America. The Horror had the Lai-Sonian king captured so he could impersonate him and order the Lai-Sonians around. After infiltrating the Lai-Sonians and taking over the Valley Port, he used their underground temple that was built to the Lai-Sonian deity Lai-Son to frightened off most visitors, and replacing many of the nearby residents with Nazi spies. Anyone who wandered into town were captured. After two FBI agents were eliminated by the Horror's minions, Betsy Ross was sent to investigate while being escorted by Pvt. Steve Rogers, secret the superhero Captain America. Betsy and Rogers uncovered the Horror's plan. With help from Rogers' sidekick Bucky and the true leader of the Lai-Sonians, Rogers buried the Lai-Sonians alive under a pile of rocks triggered by exploding TNT. The Horror and the leader of the Lai-Sonian king were then seemingly handed over to the authorities.

hook creech.name: Hook Creech
hook creech.origin: Hook Creech was one of the two men who posed as the costumed criminal known as the Mad Monk active during the days of the American Frontier, together with Frank Jepson. Creech was an outlaw who earned his nickname because he lost his left hand and had it replaced with a hook. He worked with Killer Farnam and his outlaw gang where he first encountered heroic outlaw Kid Colt, although this encounter remains unrecorded. Eventually, Creech apparently reformed and moved to the town of Hatter's Gap. Creech and Jepson began working together, inventing the Mad Monk identity that each took turns posing as in order to create alibis for each other and put question into the true identity of the Mad Monk. The pair then began robbing Wells Fargo gold shipments. During these string of robberies, they murdered the sheriff of Hatter's Gap, and Hook took over the position without an official election. In order to further distance themselves from the Mad Monk, Jepson pretended to have issue with Hook taking up the role of sheriff, while Hook became "pledged" to capturing the Monk. However, Jepson plotted to betray Hook and expose him as the Monk so that he could claim the entire fortune. The opportunity presented itself during one of their fake arguments at the local saloon. There their argument was interrupted by an old drunk named Jake. Hook threatened to beat Jake's skull in and Jepson convinced Jake to leave. When Jake camped out for the night, Jepson confronted him and bashed his head in, killing the old drunk. Jepson then hide nearby and waited for someone to discover the body. As coincidence would have it, that person turned out to be Kid Colt who was riding through the area. Jepson tried to convince the Kid to come to town and act as witness against Hook Creech. Kid Colt wanted nothing to do with the situation and rode into town, with Jepson shooting at him, injuring the Kid's horse Steel. In town, Kid Colt was confronted by Hook Creech who asked for the Kid's help in capturing the Mad Monk. Kid Colt agreed, convinced that Hook had gone clean. Jepson, then posing as the Monk robbed the local bank and fled the scene. While Hook began formulating a posse to capture the Monk, Kid Colt retired for the night. Later, Kid Colt deduced that Jepson must be the Mad Monk since he was the only one who was at the scene where Jake was killed. When Hook returned unsuccessfully, he told him so and prepared to follow Jepson's back trail. One of the men then tried to silence Kid Colt, dressed as the Mad Monk by shooting at him from the hotel room window, but failed. Kid Colt then rushed out of his room and was shocked to see Jepson in the local saloon claiming to have found the hood belonging to the Mad Monk in Hook's possession. Unsure who the Mad Monk was now, Kid Colt had Hook accompany him in tracking Jepson's backtrail. This led them to the cabin hideout of the Mad Monk. There, Hook pulled a gun on Kid Colt and revealed their entire plot, intending to kill him. However he stopped short when Kid Colt explained how he saw Jepson accusing Hook of being the Monk to the locals. Before Hook could do anything, Jepson appeared on the scene and held them at gun point. Before he could shoot Kid Colt, the Kid whistled for his horse Steel who distracted Jepson long enough for the Kid to shoot him dead. Hook managed to grab Kid Colt and ordered him to drop his guns. Kid Colt complied, but then thrust Hook into a suspended rock and sent him tumbling to his death as the land slide smashed their base.
weapons: Six-shooters, a hook in place of his left hand.

hoot temple.name: Hoot Temple
hoot temple.origin: There are two conflicting origins regarding the past of Hoot Temple. In the original account his first name was stated as being Zane Temple, a retired US Marshal who moved to Caliber City to raise a family with his wife Lucy. They had a single child named Lance Temple. When Lance was a young boy, an outlaw from "Zane's" past named Link Cado came for revenge leading to a gun battle on the Temple property. During the fight, Lucy was shot dead and "Zane" was shot in the back by Cado. "Zane" and Lance were rescued thanks to the timely arrival of Emilio Diaz and Red Hawk who forced Cado and his men to retreat. "Zane" was treated by Red Hawk, and although he would live, he was to live the rest of his life blind. "Zane" was helped to deal with his blindness thanks to Emilio and Red Hawk who also assisted him in raising young Lance. When Lance grew to adulthood, "Zane" had his son vow to never use violence to solve his problems. Lance agreed but soon learned the location of Link Cado. With the assistance of Emilio and Red Hawk, Lance fashioned the costumed identity of the Outlaw Kid and avenged his father and mother. Lance continued to operate as the Outlaw Kid in secret, being able to fight outlaws and maintain his vow to his father. However, this has been proven to be false. In reality, Hoot Temple was a simple rancher whose son Lance fought in the Civil War and returned home to practice law. When the Red Vest Gang attempted to take the Temple Ranch, Hoot tried to defend his property but was blinded when a stray bullet struck a keg of TNT. Although Lance wished revenge, Hoot believed that he was blinded because he stood up to the Red Vest Gang and had his son vow never to use his guns against another man. Lance agreed, but torn between his vow and his sense of justice, Lance developed the identity of the Outlaw Kid to avenge his father and get justice against the Red Vest Gang. Hoot lived a mostly peaceful life at his ranch with his son Lance, often sharing local gossip with his son, unaware that he was really the Outlaw Kid, and more often than not this gossip helped the Kid in his various cases. He also provided occasional relationship advice for Lance who was in a romance with Belle Taylor, who was also smitten by the mystique of the Outlaw Kid. Most importantly, Hoot always reminded Lance of his vow to abstain from violent situations, something that Lance always complied with -- at least when he was not in costume as the Outlaw Kid. However, Hoot was not immune to the dangers that Lance's double-life presented, nor was he entirely safe of the lawless nature of the time. When Brady King robbed a card game and attempted to flee the region, he briefly held Hoot hostage, until the Outlaw Kid arrived forcing King to flee, King eventually died trying to escape capture. Hoot was also threatened when Chad Burrows and his gang tried to flee the area. They demanded that Hoot provide them with fresh horses to escape the region. Once again the Outlaw Kid came to the rescue. In the aftermath, Hoot told his son Lance that he felt that had known the Outlaw Kid for many years. This was the first time that Hoot came close to discovering the Outlaw Kid's double-identity. However, when Hoot eventually discovered his son's double-identity, the shock killed him. The guilt of causing his father's death caused Lance to develop a split personality. One of these personalities believed that the he and the Outlaw Kid were two different men and that the Outlaw Kid had murdered his father.

hope london dwellers.origin: Hope was born to the Morlock known as Harmony and her husband in the sewers of London, and delivered by the X-Man, Nightcrawler. hope lee.name: Hope Lee
hope lee.origin: Hope Lee is Jubilee's paternal aunt and a renowned thief and assassin. At the time of the deaths of her brother and sister-in-law, she was in China, and did not receive word of their deaths for years. She and her brother had had a falling out and became estranged before Jubilee was born. Hope had a strained relationship with her husband and their son Eason. Her relationship with Eason was especially hostile due to her being a criminal and him working for the Hong Kong government to oversee and apprehend enhanced humans, which included his mother. They only spoke once a year for Lunar New Year in a 20 minute phone call. Upon her discovery of her niece, she and Jubilee communicated through letters before Jubilee moved to Los Angeles to join her. Shortly after Jubilee joined Hope in L.A. Hope revealed that she was an assassin. During her attempts to leave the business, she was shot, and later followed home by dozens of assassins and her boss. After sending Jubilee, Shane Shooter, (a friend of Jubilee), Wolverine, and Brad, the butler, from the house, she blew it up by unknown means. The police could not find her body and assumed she was dead. Later, in a nearby park, a jogger saw a trail of smoke, and discovered Hope Lee, whose leg was revealed to be cybernetic. Hope and Jubilee reunited when a well-intended Lady Deathstrike tried to make amends for her attempts on the lives of Jubilee and Wolverine. Hope revealed the reunion to be a trap for Yuriko to harvest her cybernetics. Hope was finally released from her contract with her employer when Jubilee bartered Yuriko's arm with the desired cybernetic parts. Hope attempted to steal a valuable canister from one of A.I.M.'s vaults in San Francisco, but she was caught and infected with the Techno-Organic Virus. Jubilee and Eason worked together to free her from the virus and defeat A.I.M.. Hope and Eason argued until Jubilee put a stop to it and the three went out for dinner.
powers: Hope is a human with cybernetic enhancements. She is extensively trained as an expert assassin.
weapons: Hope Lee is proficient in the use of small arms, and other weaponry.

hope summers moira vii 1.name: Hope Summers (Moira-VII.1)
hope summers moira vii 1.origin: After being killed by Mister Sinister, Hope was resurrected with her DNA tainted by Sinister, instilling loyalty to his cause and a personality shorn of ethics. Along with other sleeper Sinisters on the Council, she worked towards the goal of total dominion over Earth. Within 10 years, the new Quiet Council of Sinisters had effectively taken over the world, stamping out all opposition and converting most of the planet's population into modified Sinister-clones like themselves. Feeling that they should not have to blindly follow Mister Sinister, the council overrode his top-level control imprints, allowing them a greater measure of free will. They used this freedom to defy Sinister and push the world into preparations for war with the galactic powers. Within 100 years, the council had largely wiped out all intergalactic opposition. Hope, still relying on Exodus for his powers, personally oversaw the destruction of the last organized Compact resistance. Wishing to emulate her father, Hope had by this point modified her body with several cybernetic enhancements. While taking on a nest of Chitauri, Hope was betrayed by Exodus, who had become tired of her childishness, feeling that she contributed more to his faith as a dead messiah. Left stranded and unable to copy any powers, Hope was overwhelmed by the Chitauri and was killed.

hopper hertnecky.name: Hopper Hertnecky
hopper hertnecky.origin: Hopper Hertnecky was a pilot who owned his own private plane. He befriended the Thing on a movie set during a time he was estranged from the Fantastic Four. Ben shared with Hopper his woes, such as losing the ability to ever turn human again, and apparently losing his girlfriend Alicia Masters to his teammate the Human Torch. Later, during a period where he was mutated into an even more hideous form, the Thing sought out Hopper to help him get away to Monster Isle the domain of the Fantastic Four's oldest foe the Mole Man. Knowing that the Fantastic Four was looking for him, Ben then sent Hopper to tell his former teammates where his was, but to not bother trying to get him back. The Fantastic Four went anyway, and Hopper was later convinced to take the woman everyone thought was Alicia Masters to the island as well. Hopper waited on the beach until the Fantastic Four defeated the Mole Man's schemes to decimate the surface world and when the island started to sink, inflated a rubber raft, pulling the Fantastic Four on board where the waited for rescue. There he witnessed as Ben made amends with the Fantastic Four and rejoined the team. The subsequent activities of Hopper Hertnecky are unknown at this time.

hoppity harrison.name: Hoppity Harrison
hoppity harrison.first_appearance: Peter Porker, The Spectacular Spider-Ham Vol 1 2
hoppity harrison.origin: Hoppity Harrison, an anthropomorphic frog from Larval Earth, was a costumed criminal operating under the name of the Bullfrog. When doing so, he commonly dressed a brown costume with horns. The local superhero Spider-Ham was familiar with the Bullfrog's activities, and he might even have sent him to jail. In any case, Harrison spent some time in jail, during which his costume was spoiled due to moths. Harrison finally walked out of the prison legally on a pre-announced day, mere hours before the premiere of the musical The Gangland Follies. Harrison knew that a number of rich celebrities would attend to the event, and intended to go there and steal their valuables. To do so, he wanted to be dressed as the Bullfrog, so he took his costume to a tailor shop so that it could be sewed. While he went there, he was seen by Spider-Ham, who tracked him unseen. Harrison claimed to need his costume fixed for a party, and stressed the need of it for that same night, so the tailor fixed it at the moment. They ignored that Spider-Ham was eavesdropping their conversation—but Spider-Ham did not know at that moment what was the event Harrison wanted to attend that night. When Harrison left the tailor shop, Spider-Ham was unable to follow him. Harrison donned his Bullfrog costume, and disguised himself more using a trenchcoat and a sombrero to attend the premiere. He then saw celebrity Elizabeth Tabby walking the red carpet with the big Walnut Diamond with a ring on her finger. The Bullfrog discarded trenchcoat and sombrero, jumped on the other people there, and tried to take the ring off of Tabby's finger. However, Tabby was so fat that the ring was stuck in her finger. Not wanting to give in, the Bullfrog struggled with Tabby trying to take off the ring, while Tabby's couple Richard Bird-Dog stammered, unable to meddle. The Bullfrog could not even imagine that Spider-Ham was also attending the premiere in his civil identity as photographer Peter Porker. Spider-Ham also changed to his super-heroe clothes and jumped toward the wrestling Bullfrog. Taking the Bullfrog by surprise, Spider-Ham defeated him with two strong punches. The Bullfrog was knocked down unconscious and Spider-Ham gained the admiration of Tabby and the press. Spider-Ham then posed for pictures with the Bullfrog on the floor, even if the portly hero's deeds had not finished for that night. The Bullfrog was sent to the State Prison, of course deprived of his trademark costume. Some time later the Bullfrog joined other inmates, including Ducktor Doom, Dragon Lassy, and other people captured by Spider-Ham, during a prison break. Spider-Ham tried to stop them from escaping, but the villains attacked him and beat him up. However, three nearby fat cats ad-libbed a rap show to distract the villains. The villains were captivated by the act, and then taken captive again by the prison's security forces.
powers: The nefarious Bullfrog has been seen jumping on a crowd people to go through them. This might be a super-power or a mere skill.
weapons: The horns in his costume might be thought to be used as weapons, but the canon has not confirmed this yet.

horace littleton.name: Horace Littleton
horace littleton.origin: Horace Littleton was a funded scientist of the Weapon Minus program that S.H.I.E.L.D. ran in the 60s, who was developing a hybrid of the Super-Soldier Formula to find a way to perform "humane assassinations". During his time there Littleton befriended Ran Shen, the future Iron Nail, who when worried about a possible leak in S.H.I.E.L.D. while on a mission only contacted Littleton to get equipment and information. He also befriended Frank Simpson and warned him that the establishment would not stop until they turned him into their mindless weapon. Eventually Littleton developed a "L.S.D. based Super Soldier Serum hybrid". But by then his project lost its funding and had no more remaining human test subjects, so Littleton injected the serum into himself. Now under the alias of "Dr. Mindbubble" Littleton was subdued and imprisoned at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Hub sub-station in the Grand Canyon behind a door marked Weapon Minus. He allegedly spent the 50 years during which he was imprisoned in isolation finding complete tranquility within himself. Ran Shan made a failed attempt to free him in 1969, stopped only by the interference of the Winter Soldier. Littleton was eventually freed by Ran Shen when the Iron Nail detonated Nuke at the S.H.I.E.L.D. sub-station where Mindbubble had been imprisoned. After seeing that the dying Nuke had a relatively peaceful death, Littleton was asked by the Iron Nail if he was up for a "little civil disobedience". He captured Maria Hill and Nick Fury with his bubbles, controlling them and realizing his effective intentions: steal S.H.I.E.L.D.'s weapon Gungnir, a giant robot with incredible power. Then, when reached by Captain America, Horace captured him, too. Cap's dream reality was represented by him getting up from an hospital bed, with the world saved by Jet, Falcon, and Bucky, with Ian and Sharon still alive and a parade dedicated to him in the streets of New York. Realizing that he was in one of Littleton's illusions, Cap remembered about how to escape from the "dream": commit suicide inside the virtual reality (Jet discovered this by interrogating a Cyborg that was involved in the Weapon Minus project). He then awoke on the Gungnir to find out that Littleton and Shen planned on destroying a country and framing the United States. Jet Black arrived and while she fought Shen, Steve defeated Littleton by bending the tube in his forehead with his Shield. This caused all his dream bubbles to stay in his head and he went crazy. He lunged himself out the window and plummeted to his death.

horace smith.name: Horace Smith
horace smith.origin: Horace J. Smith was a successful playwright who was at the height of his career in the 1940s. He worked along with a partner, Dick Crawn, during this period, however, by early 1943, his greed got the better of him. While having guests over for a party at his hunting lodge, Horace (or Smitty as he was called by his friends) excused himself and Dick while they got to work on their next play in the woods. There, Horace pretended that his typewriter broke down just as they were getting to the part of the story where the main character was writing a suicide note, he then had Dick write out the lines by hand. After Dick wrote the phrase "I'm fed up with life, goodbye!" Horace shot him. Placing the gun in Dick's hand, Horace than ran back towards the house. There he tossed some of the pages he typed leading up to the "suicide" into the fireplace then returned to the scene of the crime and pretended as though they had finished writing, and he was returning his typewriter when the murder happened. However, Horace's plot would crumble apart the moment the Vision appeared, disputing the idea that Dick's death was a suicide. Nobody believed the Vision; however, the hero began piecing clues and began writing a one act play that would prove who the killer was. Meanwhile, Horace and his friend were all taken to court to testify about the death of Dick Crawn, and the judge also ruled it a suicide. However, when the Vision later had two of Horace's actors act out what he suspected really happened, Horace snapped and confessed to the whole thing. He attempted to shoot the Vision with a hunting rifle but missed and was chased into the woods. Fearful of capture, Smith was not watching where he was going and stumbled off a cliff and fell to his death.
weapons: Horace had a hunting rifle.

horace vanderveer.name: Horace Vanderveer
horace vanderveer.origin: Horace Vanderveer was the manager of the National Bank. He secretly plotted to rob it, hiring a gang of thugs to rob the bank. Vanderveer, however, didn't foresee interference from the newly powered hero the Human Top. The Top stopped the thieves and, unaware that Vanderveer had hired them, brought the stolen money directly with him. When Vanderveer tried to shoot the hero, he humiliated him by leaving him on his chandelier. Horace took the money and attempted to flee the country in his yacht, leaving the Top to be framed for the theft. The Top ultimately tracked Horace down, and after defeating his thugs, threatened Vanderveer by placing him on the top of a flag pole. When Horace agreed to confess and turn himself over to the police, the Top let him down and left him for the authorities.
weapons: Horace wielded a handgun.

horatio.name: Horatio
horatio.origin: Horatio was a doll maker who ran a shop during the 1940s. He loved his creations so much he began to believe that they had their own personalities and soon came to the point that he could not be parted from them. By 1948, his business was floundering and his landlord began demanding that he pay what he owed in back rent or he threatened to take possession of the dolls and sell them for the money owed. Horatio then hired a band of criminal midgets to dress up as his dolls and help him commit robberies to keep his store in business. Around this time, Horatio was slowly becoming unhinged and began believing that his minions were real dolls. On the day when Horatio's landlord gave him one more day to pay what he owed him, his store was visited by Jeff Mace and Betsy Ross (secretly Captain America and Golden Girl) who found his dolls (and his eccentric behavior) interesting. Later that night, Horatio sent his minions to rob a local bank, killing the night watchman. Captain America and Golden Girl rushed to the scene and chased the tiny crooks back to Horatio's doll shop. There they used a trap door to switch places with the real dolls before the two heroes arrive. Baffled, Captain America and Golden Girl were cast out of the store by Horatio who was roused awake by their entry. The following day Jeff and Betsy paid another visit and were surprised when Horatio suddenly had the money to pay off his landlord. Jeff then mentioned how much of a shame that Horatio did not have the priceless ruby doll house owned by Mrs. Waggoner to house his dolls. thumb|left|195px|Horatio's "dolls" in action. This was a plant to lure Horatio and his minions into committing another robbery, and Horatio took the bait. When Captain America and Golden Girl attacked, the midgets were rounded up, but Horatio managed to escape. Rushing back to his doll shop the crazed store owner begged his dolls for forgiveness, and surprisingly, they came to life and sentenced him to death. Hearing his dying screams, Captain America and Golden Girl rushed into Horatio's shop and found him dead with his throat cut and his blood on the blade of the puppet he called the Axe-Slayer of Nan-king. This left the two heroes to wonder if the dolls really did come to life and kill their master.

horatio cringebottom.name: Horatio Cringebottom
horatio cringebottom.origin: Along with technician Bert, agent Horatio Cringebottom, a civil servant, was dispatched on missions. Bert handled any technology, and Horatio handled the paperwork. Widget, a mechanical being who was a member of the superhero team Excalibur, was accidentally breaking the rules of interdimensional travel when Saturnyne gave the order to go to Earth-616. Saturnyne had known about the issue for a while but put off fixing it, and the timing of her finally giving the job to Horatio and Bert was apparently not coincidental, as it meant their arrival was timed to interrupt a fight between Excalibur and the Technet. Excalibur was engaged in a losing conflict with Gatecrasher and her Technet when suddenly their adversaries stopped responding to strikes. When a pair of people suddenly appeared among them in a blaze of light, one of them revealed to the heroes that he was responsible for this unexpected turn of events. He introduced himself respectively, and said that they were agents of Saturnyne, assigned "to prosecute a writ about multiple infractions of interdimensional transit restrictions." The two explained that they were there to get Widget, contrary to Nightcrawler's assumption that Horatio was planning to take the Technet away for these infractions. Widget was taken from Bert's magnificent and ever-expanding toolbox when he opened it. Bert therefore made an effort to describe, "in tiny terms," how the device would merely prevent Widget from traveling to realities. After completing the task, Bert put his tools away and continued to fling himself at an uninterested Kitty Pryde. Horatio first reprimanded Bert for violating the rules against interacting with lesser lifeforms before offering his condolences to the heroes. Captain Britain noted that the team was losing a battle when they arrived and expressed surprise that Gatecrasher was attacking them. Captain Britain received a message crystal from Horatio to give to Gatecrasher after she came out of stasis. ===Captain Britain's Wedding=== At the wedding of Brian Braddock and Meggan on Earth-616, Horatio and Bert were in attendance. Horatio was horrified that he would be made to perform the menial task of taking pictures at weddings. As they prepared the new bride and groom for their pictures, Tweedledope leapt in front of the bride and groom, was blinded by the flash, and knocked a plate of hors d'oeuvres into Hauptmann Englande, who chased after the creature. Bert then used his interdimensional transmitter to relay messages from friends who could not attend the wedding: Spider-Man, Captain America and Black Knight.

horatio cutlass.name: Horatio Cutlass
horatio cutlass.origin: Captain Cutlass was a seventeenth-century pirate captain who sailed the seas aboard a three-masted vessel alongside his loyal crew. During his lifetime, however, he and his men were captured by Collector, who added the entire ship and crew to his vast intergalactic collection. To preserve them as curiosities, the Collector reduced both the vessel and its inhabitants to miniature size and sealed them within a bottle-like prison aboard his starship. Advanced life-sustaining technology prolonged their existence for centuries. Roughly three hundred years later, during the modern era, the Collector temporarily released Captain Cutlass and his crew in order to aid in the hunt for escaped captives within the Florida swamps near Omegaville. Among their targets was Bruce Banner, the human counterpart of the Hulk. The pirates eventually cornered Banner, and Cutlass personally struck him during the confrontation. Banner retaliated, transforming into the Hulk amid the struggle. Though Cutlass and his men attempted to overpower the Hulk through sheer numbers, conventional weapons and brute force proved ineffective against the giant. Only the combined intervention of the mind-controlled Man-Thing and the Glob succeeded in subduing him. The unconscious Hulk was transported back to the Collector’s ship, where Captain Cutlass and his crew helped restrain the captured monsters with stasis shackles. Once their task was complete, the Collector struck the pirates with an energy discharge that restored them to their reduced size and confined them once more aboard their miniature ship within the starship’s prison chambers. Later, when the Hulk escaped and destroyed portions of the Collector’s containment systems, many prisoners fled the vessel only to perish after leaving the range of the technology that had sustained them for centuries. Captain Cutlass and his crew, however, remained trapped within their miniature prison aboard the damaged spacecraft.

horatio huxley.name: Horatio Huxley
horatio huxley.origin: Dr Horatio Huxley was a physician at Department H and was prominently placed as he reported directly to the Director. He had a wide range of projects under his supervision. He headed the Helios Project, which was dedicated to studying the Japanese super-hero Sunfire. He was one of those supervising the development of the new Beta Flight (synthetic replacements of Alpha Flight). He performed experiments on Diamond Lil. He communicated with Nick Fury about Wolverine/"Private Logan"'s past in the Canadian Army, his involvement in the Spanish Civil War and World War I, and his confrontation with Silas Burr. Huxley kidnapped a tourist from New Zealand who was touring Department H. Huxley infected the tourist with Thetagen-24, the most dangerous, lethal bacteria created. The tourist was not the first test subject but he became a sympathetic carrier, with the bacteria consuming him, and mutating. His mind and body combined with the infection, resulting in a new being: Weapon X.

horatio piper.name: Horatio Piper
horatio piper.origin: Horatio Piper was a professor at Empire State University. He brought the unusual white African chieftan Micah Synn to New York City under the auspices of the University and attempted to assimilate him into society. Piper spent most of his time cancelling media events while trying to contain Synn's boorish behavior and excessive violence. Too late he realized what savages he'd brought to civilization when Synn practically admitted they were attempting to hold human sacrifices. When the opportunity presented itself for Debbie Nelson, with whom Micah had been having an abusive affair with, to escape, Piper provided a distraction. However, he ran beneath a stake-covered slab in front of the Kinjorge's idol while doing so, and Micah's shaman cut the rope holding it up, killing the professor.
powers: Normal

horde gammaworld.name: Horde (Gammaworld)
horde gammaworld.species: Various humans and a dog mutated and fused together by gamma radiation
horde gammaworld.first_appearance: World War Hulk Aftersmash: Warbound Vol 1 2
horde gammaworld.origin: The creature known as Horde is a collective being made up of several inhabitants living in the town of Stoneridge, New Mexico consisting of Horacio Carrenas, Elmira Phillips, Joe Famiglia, Floyd Henderson, Bacon the Dog, and other unidentified individuals. While protesting against the local law enforcement after their apartment building was condemned, Leader activated his Gammaworld dome fusing the individuals together. The only thought they had was sticking together. Leader took advantage of that and told them that a pack of aliens were moving the rest of the civilians out of town. Determined to keep the rest of the civilians in the dome, Horde attacked the Warbound. During Horde's fight with the Warbound, Hiroim used his powers to blast it away. Horde later returned with an army of mind-controlled humans who are ready to destroy the Warbound for Leader. After Leader was defeated, the humans were free from the mind-control. Leader then teleported away leaving the Warbound, Horde, and the remaining humans still in the Gammaworld dome.
powers: Horde demonstrated that it had superhuman strength. Horde is highly resistant to injury.

horff.name: Horff
horff.origin: Horff was a Skrull who deserted the battle during the Secret Invasion and went into hiding. Later, with the help of Nazum, a Skrull stormtrooper who was also stranded on Earth, they tried to recover a hidden ship to return to their planet, but they didn't realize that Nazum was recovering a warship. Opposed to Nazum's actions, Horff and the other two defecting Skrulls helped Pixie bring the warship back to Earth before Nazum armed the bombs inside. Afterward, Horff and the other Skrulls returned to their homeworld but left Nazum on an uninhabited planet after he threatened to expose the other three as defectors.

horguun.name: Horguun
horguun.origin: Horguun was a Rock Troll whose metalforge was accessible from different realms, including Earth. One of the "doors" for his forge was found in the Arctic. He developed for Mys-Tech a variety of weapons to be used with mystical bullets. When S.H.I.E.L.D. investigated a series of attempted murders, all of which their victims had been magic-users, they retrieved a gun with Horguun's signature, as identified by Doctor Strange. Agents May and Fitz, and the Scarlet Witch located Horgunn's forge and confronted him about the guns and the mystical bullets. After Horguun admitted not knowing the origin of the bullets, the Agents and the Scarlet Witch left his forge, but not before Wanda used the metal of Horgunn's forge to melt the cache of guns.

Horse and his gang linked up with Rogue, Rachel, Magneto, and Gambit to save the X-lost men's teammates, Havok and Polaris, on another occasion. This was not voluntarily; Sovel had lost his leadership to Rogue during a duel in which he had chosen Horse to fight Rogue as his proxy.

horse valkyrior steed.name: Horse (Valkyrior Steed)
horse valkyrior steed.origin: Ironically nicknamed "Horse" by Wolverine, this steed belonged to the Valkyries until they were all killed during the Dark Council's attack on Manhattan. When Captain America assembled the Jotunheim Strikeforce to retrieve Thor from the land of the Frost Giants, five horses volunteered to carry the heroes in their quest. Shortly after arriving to Jotunheim, the Strikeforce was attacked by Frost Giant archers, and "Horse" was impaled by an arrow. Other three horses also died, leaving Arctorius as the only survivor of the attack. She mourned for them, and stayed behind to usher their souls to the afterlife while the heroes moved forward.

Twisted by grief, she started infecting other people with the virus who "deserved it more", in an insane attempt to balance the scales. She followed Nomad from Fort Worth to Dallas, moving her infection activities along with him. This led to Jack discovering her secret, and turning "The Needle" over to the authorities - but not before she infected herself, expecting to die in the following years.

horst eisele.name: Horst Eisele
horst eisele.origin: Horst Eisele was a veteran HYDRA assassin distinguished by a severe facial scar and a long record of successful operations. Beginning his career under El Jaguar, he rose through the organization’s hierarchy to become a section chief, earning a reputation as one of HYDRA’s most efficient field commanders. When the Crimson Cowl threatened to reveal the Thunderbolts location, HYDRA acted quickly on the intelligence. Eisele led the strike team sent to eliminate them, launching an assault at the Mountview Grill. Armed with replicated versions of Jackhammer’s weaponry, he confronted Atlas directly while coordinating his operatives against the rest of the team. Eisele’s offensive faltered when Hawkeye entered the fight and rallied the Thunderbolts. A sonic arrow incapacitated Eisele, and Moonstone—pretending to possess psychic abilities—convinced him she had extracted his knowledge.
powers: Vest enabled Super-Strength, Flight, and Power Fists

horst lederer.name: Horst Lederer
horst lederer.origin: As a Nazi soldier, Horst Lederer found himself in a bunker next to the one the Red Skull (Johann Shmidt) was fighting Captain America in at the end of World War II. As Cap defeated the Skull, allied bombers destroyed the bunkers, entrapping Lederer alongside fellow soldier Wolfgang Brenner and Schmidt himself. Luckily, the destruction also released an experimental gas which put the three men into suspended animation. thumb|left Decades later, the three were recovered and revived by AIM with the intent to use them to defame and frame Captain America for murder. Horst himself carried out the third phase of the plan to attempt to frame Cap using the Hypno-Helmet AIM had provided the men. However, Cap managed to figure out how they were affecting him and had SHIELD build him a hypno-protection circuit for his cowl. Cap surprised Horst, defeating him and causing him to reveal that the Red Skull had survived the bunker bombings. thumb|left|Serving Red Skull Unfortunately, the experimental gas the men were exposed to was not as effective as the Super Soldier Serum. Not long after his defeat, Horst was next seen as a much older man in servitude to the Skull, who was also aging rapidly. When he advised the Skull that he was not well and should take things easy, he was rewarded for his efforts with a swift blow to the neck. The blow ultimately cut Horst's life short, and he died the next day at Skull-House. While Red Skull seemed to be upset by Horst's death, he insisted he was only interested in the effects of the gas.
powers: Longer lifespan than most humans, as he spent several decades in suspended animation.
abilities: Seemed larger and stronger than typical human men, though this was not identified to be true for certain.
weapons: Implemented a gun as a soldier and during the attempted murder meant for Cap's rap sheet.
affiliations: Soldier and later servant to Red Skull (Johann Shmidt)

horvald.origin: Horvald, Aslak, and Grolf were a trio of Storm Giants who had gotten lost and wandered into Asgard after a feast with the Mountain Giants. They stumbled onto Vidar's farm and found Solveig. When they discovered whose farm they on they slaughtered the animals and Solveig tried to stop them but Grolf killed her and Horvald took her belt. They traveled back to Horvald's castle in Jotunheim and after another drink, passed out, allowing Horvald's wife Thrunhild to take the belt. They awoke sometime later and discovered Vidar over the corpse of Thrunhild and fought him. They overpowered Vidar and took him to their castle and begin to torture him. Vidar was rescued by Thor and forced the giants to flee but were stopped by Hoder. Vidar initially planned to slay the giants in vengeance but was talked out of it by Thor.

hoss demon.name: Hoss (Demon)
hoss demon.origin: Hoss was a Demon from Hell in service of Lucifer. He made the grandiose claim that he was sent to Hell after committing suicide in life out of sheer embarrassment. He is one of Hell's best bounty hunters and trackers, rivaling only the Ghost Rider himself. He travels the Earth looking for rogue demons and souls to drag back to Hell. Whilst driving through the state of Texas, he was assaulted by a gang of bikers; in retaliation, Hoss killed them all and revived them as a single terrible amalgamation which he named Buttview, who now served him as his assistant. It was on one of the hunts was he met the current Ghost Rider, Johnny Blaze. Hoss was tracking the fallen angel and now rogue Demon Kazann. Hell had ordered Hoss to find Kazann whilst the angel; Malachi dragged the Ghost Rider back from Hell, to track him down as well. The two of coursed clashed on their first meeting but eventually decided to work together as they are on the same mission. The pair was then ambushed by the Archangel Ruth, who hurled a bus full of people and the bounty hunters. The three finally decided to team up to return Kazann back to Hell. The three bounty hunters defeated Kazan, and he was returned to Hell, along with the Ghost Rider. Ghost Rider realized that he had been betrayed by his angel benefactor Malachi. The truth is revealed that the two angels Malachi and Kazann had been secretly plotting together since Lucifer's original rebellion. The pair was playing both sides against each other to boost their careers and power. Malachi left Heaven and arrogantly descended into to Hell to confront the Ghost Rider. Malachi was taken by surprise when he was ambushed by Ruth and Hoss, who along Ghost Rider defeated the Angel. Ruth ripped his wings off, and he was converted into a mortal state. He was then killed and his sole was dragged back to Hell. Hoss actually apologized to the Rider as he did not have the power to release him from Hell. Hoss tried to console the Rider by offering a consolation prize, the shared torture of Malachi.
abilities: Hoss is able to track other demons.

hotamintanio.name: Hotamintanio
hotamintanio.origin: Hotamintanio was the god of warriors for the Manidoog, an extra-dimensional race of beings still worshiped by the tribes of North America. Specifically, Hotamintanio was revered as a symbol of the warrior's heart and the god of the Cheyenne Dog Soldiers ("Hotamétaneo'o") which were his namesake. In modern times, Hotamintanio allied with Calumet and Nanabozho to start gaining vengeance on the white Europeans for their acts against the native populations. They tried to recruit Owayodata and Red Wolf but they refused and were captured in the process. This brought them to the attention of Doctor Strange and Black Crow. Strange fought them, on their home dimension, freed Owayodata and the group was eventually able to make them see the error of there ways.

hotath.name: Hotath
hotath.origin: ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== Hotath (or Hothath) was one of the gods of the Pre-Cataclysmic Age, and was worshiped by the Empire of Atlantis, in which many virgins were sacrificed on their altars, in Valusia (though at least some Valusians considered Hotath to be an "heathen god"), and in Lemuria. ===Hyborian Age=== During the Hyborian Age of Conan, circa 10,000 BC, a renowned mystic in the Mountains of Night summoned familiars, invoking Hotath and Semptor to share their wisdom of the future, but was driven near to madness by a vision of Soggoth.

In "The Fiend from the Forgotten City" ( ; July, 1974), the demon named on the cover as the "Fiend from the Forgotten City" was stated to be the "minion of Hotath and Helgor", then the "minion of the Deep Gods", hinting both Hotath and Helgor are "Deep Gods".

hotness.name: Hotness
hotness.origin: Hotness was a member of the Freelancers, a group of super-powered enforcers who were hired by Roxxon to shut down the protesters at the Angeles National Forest that opposed the company's intention to build a pipeline that connected their West Coast headquarters to a new deep-water drilling platform off the coast. When the Champions arrived to the scene to stop them, Might directed Hotness to run for the woods and set off a fire that could be blamed on the protesters. Spider-Man and Nova followed him. As soon as they caught up with him, a monster that originated from the Leviathon Tide landed on the area, knocking out Hotness with the impact of its landing. Spider-Man saved him and later brought him to the bus Viv used to evacuate all the protesters from the area. The Freelancers were later hired for other jobs, including disrupting a wage protest in Durham, North Carolina and displacing homeless people from a tent city in Los Angeles, California. The Freelancers invited two of the homeless people they displaced to their compound, and manipulated them into fighting each other, later using Panic's powers to have them tell the authorities that the Champions had assaulted them.
powers: Hotness has the ability to generate fire from his hands.

hound of cardiff moor.name: Hound of Cardiff Moor
hound of cardiff moor.origin: Murdock's unnamed hound was his personal pet. Angry that his family's former land had been taken over by other people and split into various properties, Murdock decided to his father's vow that his would destroy any who would come to live in Cardiff Moor to his advantage. He covered his hound in luminescent paint and sent it out to attack the moor's residents before dressing up in a hound costume and killing them. Murdock's actions caught the attention of Captain America and Bucky who stationed in nearby Camp Lehigh. They went to Cardiff to investigate. After Murdock failed to scare the two heroes off, he joined them and some of the Moor's other residents in a search for the ghost hound. Murdock eventually broke off from the ground and sent out his hound to kill everyone while he dressed up in his hound costume. After Murdock and his hound killed a writer named Ramon, they went after Murdock's neighbor Mary Scott. Mary was rescued by Captain America who killed the hound by snapping its neck and defeating Murdock in a fight. Murdock was then unmasked, and his scheme uncovered.
powers: Those of a typical dog
abilities: The hound was well trained and responded to Murdock's commands.
weapons: Its teeth

house killer.name: House Killer
house killer.origin: The man known as the House Killer was a criminal who was active in the 1940s. In 1946 he learned that a boarded up house owned by John Kirk in the area was once used for making gold plating and that the house's structure was loaded with hold dust that could be extracted to make a fortune. This was learned at the time when there was currently a housing crisis going on in New York City. When Kirk decided to repair the house to rent out to potential tenants, the crook developed the identity of the House Killer to distract the authorities from his real plan. The House Killer and his men removed the house from the property and replaced it with a hollow replica and lit it on fire. Then left a note that proclaimed the house was destroyed by someone angry at Kirk for refusing to rent a place out to them. The resulting explosion attracted the attention of the Human Torch and Toro. In order to further throw off the heroes investigation, the House Killer set up another fake house and set it to go off. However, he was interrupted, and even though the House Killer doused them in flame retarding chemicals he only succeeded in blowing the roof off his fake house, allowing the Torch and Toro to realize part of his scheme. The House Killer then went to the city records office to destroy the information on the Kirk house. They were once more opposed by the Human Torch and Toro, but they were once more knocked out and the House Killer succeeded in destroying most of the report on the Kirk house. However, part of the report survived tipping off the Torch as to what the House Killer's plan was. They managed to track them down to the chemical factory that they were using to extract the gold dust out of the housing materials and busted the crooks. Turned over to the authorities, the House Killer confessed his plans. His subsequent activities are unknown.
weapons: The House Killer used explosives and also had access to a chemical gas that could douse the Human Torch and Toro's flames.

house of shadows.name: House of Shadows
house of shadows.species: An entity from another dimension that came to Earth
house of shadows.origin: The House of Shadows was an old cottage on the outskirts of New York City that was rumored to be haunted. When a TV reporter entered the house to investigate, he was swallowed by the mystical forces of the house. Doctor Strange ventured into the house to free the journalist and learned that the house was a visitor from a shadow world that bordered a pocket realm near Limbo, that came to Earth to observe humanity. Strange banished the house to its home dimension. The Galadorian Spaceknights were exiling their enemies, the Dire Wraiths, to the same Limbo, and when the remaining Wraiths tried to recover their imprisoned peers, they accidentally made the House of Shadows return to Earth, where it was encountered by Rom the Spaceknight, Steve Jackson, and Brandy Clark. While on the run from the forces of the Dire Wraiths, the trio entered an abandoned house, which then tried to carry off Steve and Brandy. Dr. Strange contacted ROM via a dream, and told ROM the true nature of the house. Using this knowledge, ROM used his Neutralizer to cast the entity to Limbo. Once more the entity made its way back to Earth, this time taking the shape of the top floor of a condominium. The disappearances of the building's residents caught the attention of Dr. Strange, who recognized the patterns of the entity. Strange used the opportunity to test his disciple Rintrah. Rintrah used the same methods as his teacher, and cast the entity back to its realm once again. The House of Shadows reappeared on Earth, taking the form of the top floor of an apartment building. When people started going missing, a neighbor went to Moon Knight for help. He ventured into the building's floor, but it eventually casted him out after an attempt to connect with Moon Knight's fractured mind caused it agony. After seeking help from Wong, Moon Knight learned about the floor's true nature as the House of Shadows. Finding compassion for the House, Moon Knight offered to help it fulfill its desire to be lived in. The House of Shadows then took over the ruins of the offices of Moon Knight's Midnight Mission, refurbishing Moon Knight's base of operations and becoming it. The House of Shadows protected Reese and Soldier while Zodiac was coming for them, but they left its protection when their neighbors were threatened. Resuming functions as an office space, the House of Shadows utilized its magical spaces to psychologically punish Nemean and Grand Mal. After Moon Knight's death stopping the Black Spectre, the Shroud took up his identity. He tried to claim the Mission as his headquarters, but the living building violently rejected him. During the Blood Hunt, the Midnight Mission acted as a shelter for civilians. The Midnight Mission began going after Achilles Fairchild's criminal gang, causing the criminal mastermind to organize a plan to take them down. In preparation for the NYPD storming the Midnight Mission, Fairchild sent his agent by the name of Carver to prevent the House of Shadows from helping them. She went to the top of the building where she proceeded to stab it with her magic sword, possessed by the spirit of the soul-hoarding dragon Ginnarr, which absorbed the House's soul, seemingly killing it. The Midnight Mission was able to regroup and defeat Fairchild and his forces, with Moon Knight claiming Ginnarr as his own weapon. After their defeat, the Midnight Mission through a joint celebration of their victory and a birthday party for Moon Knight himself in order to reiterate to the people of New York that the Mission was still with them. During this celebration Moon Knight, realizing that if the Hoarding Blade could steal and hold the House's soul he could also be forced to return it, went to the rooftop and plunged the blade in, demanding the House's soul return to it. With Ginnarr now bound to Marc and Khonshu's will, he complied, and the return of its soul caused the House of Shadows to return to life once more.
abilities: Protection of residents against outside forces
weaknesses: The House of Shadows is not only weak against strong magic, but also the feeling of certain minds
such as Moon Knight's unique psychic imprint, which caused the supernatural space to spit him out like tainted food.

howard mason.name: Howard Mason
howard mason.origin: The Skrull that adopted the identity of Howard Mason was an inhabitant of Kral X, a small colony part of the Kral System. The Kral System represented a peculiar portion of the Skrull Empire, a group of planets dedicated solely to the recreation of Earth's culture and media. In the case of Kral X, its prince used it to emulate the 50-year-old TV series The Ritchie Redwood Show, with Howard Mason being one of the characters of its cast, and the identity one of Kral X's Skrulls adopted. While strolling through a market in another planet, Mason discovered the MIA U.S.Avenger Cannonball being sold as a slave. Mason bought him and took him to Kral X so to have a real Earther to learn from.

howard mitchell.name: Howard Mitchell
howard mitchell.origin: Howard Mitchell was the owner of an armored truck company, but was unsatisfied with his personal profits. He decided then to steal his own trucks. To do so, he created a costumed identity including independently developed technology. He used a knock-out, amnesia-inducing gas he learned about from a voyage to Peru, wearing a gas-mask to became the Hijacker. As the Hijacker was familiar with all of the secrets of Mitchell's company, he managed to perform four successful thefts. He never killed a witness, because witnesses could not identify him due to temporary amnesia. The police was unable to stop the Hijacker. Mitchell, feigning anger, demanded the help of a superhero: Ant-Man (Hank Pym). Mitchell felt that such a small hero could be no threat to him. The Ant-Man in turn understood that someone in the company was helping the Hijacker, or was the Hijacker himself. After seeing some Peruvian statues in Mitchell's office, he related them to the Peruvian gas used by the Hijacker and immediately suspected of Mitchell. Thus, the Ant-Man pretended to suffer from appendicitis and in secret hid in one of the trucks: In other case, the Hijacker would not attack. The Hijacker attacked the truck believing that he would not have to fight, but he met the Ant-Man, who was using a gas-proof mask of his own. Ant-Man fought the Hijacker, defeated him and revealed he knew it had been Mitchell all the time. Mitchell was then sent to jail. Mitchell eventually escaped or was freed, and decided to change his modus operandi: The Hijacker would steal technology and re-sell it in black market auctions. He tried to steal Anthony Stark's designs at Stark West, but he met with Black Goliath and the Thing, who were performing some tests. Hijacker understood he was no match for both of them together, so he escaped and returned with a new trick: His own armored tank. Nevertheless, in a fight, Black Goliath and the Thing destroyed the tank and captured the Hijacker. When the Hijacker tried to reveal his real name (probably thinking that cooperation would reduce his term), the Thing showed little interest on anything he could say. Months after that, the Hijacker discovered that the Thing was hospitalized due to injuries caused by Gladiator and the Champion of the Universe. It was a great chance for getting his revenge on him. Other villains had also thought about it, but in fact superheroes who were the Thing's friends had thought of that, and gathered in the hospital to protect him. Although the Hijacker used a new tank in the attack, it was destroyed by Iron Man, who also apprehended him. Free again through unknown means, the Hijacker was contacted by Gary Gilbert, a former customed criminal turned into business agent for criminals. Gilbert was worried about the Scourge of the Underworld, a masked figure who was killing customed criminals such as Gilbert and Mitchell. Gilbert organized a meeting in the Bar with No Name, Medina County, Ohio, to discuss potential counter-attacks. As the Scourge was known to use weapons instead of powers, weapons were to be left at the door, leaving Mitchell helpless. However, the Scourge infiltrated in the meeting disguised as the bartender and shot down all the seventeen criminals (including Mitchell) wielding a cut-down .50 submachine gun in each hand. After Spider-Island, Mitchell - resurrected by The Hood - decided to rob a bank with his truck, but was chased by Venom after he ran over a security guard. During the pursuit, Hijacker squashed a mother and his son, killing them. Enraged, Venom hid in Hijacker's truck and faced him in his hideout. He broke Hijacker's fingers, hit him many times and bit his head off before spitting it out.
abilities: Knowledge of high technology and of Peruvian culture. He was well-practiced in shooting his vario-blaster.

howard nees.name: Howard Nees
howard nees.origin: Howard Nees used to be a C.P.A. in Miami until he fell in with the wrong crowd, in the process discovering an inner Howard Nees that was dying to come out. He moved to New York City, where he became the city's main peddler of synthetic heroin. Howard confronted the Kingpin at every turn and started a mob war by shooting at his dealers and killing innocent bystanders. The Kingpin had Microchip kidnapped and sent one of his fingers to the Punisher. He forced the Punisher to take out Howard Nees and shut down his operations, or receive more pieces of Microchip. The men that Howard sent to kill the Punisher were killed by claymore mines. Howard then led an attack on the Kingpin's trucking company but was ambushed enroute by the Punisher, who took out the attacking force and killed Howard.

fields.notes: In "The Shadow From the Steeple" (September, 1950) by Robert Bloch, this character was originally Howard Phillips Lovecraft himself. In the adaptation of that story in (June, 1973), Lovecraft was renamed Howard Phillips. This story was a sequel to "The Haunter of the Dark" (December, 1936) by H.P. Lovecraft, adapted in (April, 1973), and in which Robert Blake (based on Robert Bloch) was killed. It was itself a sequel of "The Shambler from the Stars" (September, 1935) by Robert Bloch, in which a reclusive scholar living in Providence, and based on Lovecraft, was killed. In the adaptation of that story in (February, 1973), the reclusive scholar was penciled by Jim Starlin in traits resembling H.P. Lovecraft. While this character is to be considered separated from Howard Phillips Lovecraft, Lovecraft is himself a character on his own in the Marvel Universe, being mentioned on occasion.

howard saint.name: Howard Saint
howard saint.origin: Howard Saint was a ruthless mobster. After his son Bobby was killed by Frank Castle, Howard ordered the whole man's family to be killed in revenge. Thinking Castle had died in the attack, Saint was pleased. When the Toro brothers, a pair of Cuban mobsters, complain about a failed trade in Saint's territory, and a huge amount of money was lost, Howard realized that Castle was still alive and on a personal vendetta against him. He hired two assassins, Harry Heck and The Russian, to kill him. Meanwhile, Castle, with the aid of the criminal Micky Duka (who has his own reasons for hating the Saints), made Howard believe that his wife Livia was cheating on him with his best friend Quentin Glass (who is actually homosexual) with false evidence planted by Castle, found by Saint himself. Howard believed he has a confirmation of the two's affair when he finds Livia's earring on Quentin's pillow in his home (actually planted by Castle). After a confrontation, Howard killed Quentin, with the latter not knowing why. Later, he killed his wife Livia. He was then killed by Castle who reveals he planted the evidence and that he killed his wife and friend for nothing.

howard shelton.name: Howard Shelton
howard shelton.origin: thumb|left|200px Howard Shelton was a soldier in the 1940s. He met Zarda, ambassador from Utopia Isle, when she first ventured into the outside world and joined the Golden Agency as "Power Princess". The two married when they were both still young, but while Zarda remained young and vital as the decades passed, Howard aged naturally. Old and frail, Howard lived with his wife at Squadron City after the Utopia Program began. When an evil doppelganger of Hyperion infiltrated the Squadron, however, he decided he wanted Zarda for himself. Hyperion went to the Shelton's house one night and used his super-lungs to draw the air out of Howard's lungs, killing him in his sleep.

During his trip to the planet Zoonga, Howie stole and used a Zoonganian camera to take a picture of Earth against the will of the Zoonganians who described their cameras as weapons. While back on Earth Howie developed the negative which he accidently burned and when that happened he and the entirety of Earth turned black and white as if they were a photo negative. After confessing his crime of stealing and using the camera Howie convinced them to allow him to return to space and take another photo to fix his mistake. After taking another photo and returning to Earth to develop it he soon learned that the photo turned out white which resulted in the entire Earth also turning white.

howling wolf.name: Howling Wolf
howling wolf.origin: Howling Wolf was a Native American criminal who was active during the days of the American Frontier. He was incarcerated in a Dallas prison until he broke out in the year 1846. Desiring revenge against the white men who imprisoned him, Howling Wolf began traveling across Texas setting fire to ranches by night and sleeping by day. His reign of terror attracted the attention of the Texas Kid who tracked Howling Wolf for days. Howling Wolf got he drop on the Kid and buried him up to his neck in dirt intending to leave the western hero for the buzzards. The Kid whistled for his faithful horse Thunder who knocked Howling Wolf out with his hooves. Thunder then pulled the Texas Kid out of the ground and the hero shot Howling Wolf dead, leaving his corpse for the vultures to feed on.
abilities: Howling Wolf was an expert survivalist and tracker.
weapons: Howling Wolf was armed with six-guns, a rifle and various knives.

hriedmar.name: Hriedmar
hriedmar.origin: Hriedmar was a Vanir and the tenant of an Inn. He had three sons: Regin, Fafnir, and Otr the Changer of Shapes from a witch of Svartalfheim, and lived with his sons in his inn. A day where he had been sent by Hriedmar as a human-sized otter to catch a supper, Otr encountered the young prince Odin Borson and the time-travelling Loki. While Odin was astonished by the creature who greeted them welcome, Loki quickly killed it. His meat was eaten, and from his fur were made two cloaks. When Loki and Odin came to the Inn and listened to Hriedmar talking about his third son, Odin quickly understood that they had killed Otr. As soon, Fafnir and Regin entered in arms, recognizing Otr's fur on the two travelers backs. While Regin intended to avenge in blood, Fafnir succumbed to Loki's tempting, implying a blood price with a ransom of gold. First going with Regin, Hriedmar accepted, taking Odin as hostage. Loki went to Andvari the Dwarf, killed him and stole his gold, but not before he could curse the it, who would be revealing the truth about people. After the two travelers departed, Regin was in favor of hunting them and all Asgardians down, but Hriedmar tried to appease him, before Fafnir was driven by the curse to stab them both, for him to keep the gold for himself. Hriedmar was killed, and Regin buried him and Otr, oathing the death of Fafnir and all Asgardians. Regin and Fafnir would eventually be killed, but those events would be the settings for crucial beings of the Nine Worlds.

hu sha.name: Hu Sha
hu sha.origin: Hu Sha became a refugee when the Korean War broke out in the early 1950s. Her and her parents supported the United Nations that were on the side of South Korea. Early on in the war she befriended an American corporal named Joe who gave her perfume as a gift. Tragedy struck when her family home was attacked by the Chinese guerilla fighter known as Manchuria Mary who murdered her parents and stole the bottle of perfume. Seeking vengeance, Hu Sha vowed to capture Mary and turn her over to American soldiers who were active in the area. In her hunt for Mary, Hu Sha came across the American soldiers Battle Brady and Socko Swenski who were just recently knocked out by Manchuria Mary just moments earlier. When the two soldiers came around, and still unsure the true identity of Manchuria Mary began to argue over if Hu Shan was the woman they were after or not. Hearing Manchuria Mary coming back with a troop of female soldiers, Hu Sha knocked the two soldiers out again and hid in the bushes. When Manchuria Mary and her troops returned, Hu Sha got the drop on them and threatened to blow them up with a grenade. When Battle and Socko came around again, Hu Sha pointed out the real Manchuria Mary, recognizing the perfume she was wearing as the brand that she stole from her. Hu Sha then turned over Mary and her minions over to Socko and Battle. Hu Sha kissed Battle in thanks for his assistance in helping her avenge her family. However, Manchuria Mary and her minions managed to escape their captivity. Mary tracked down Hu Sha and took her prisoner in revenge for her earlier capture. Mary almost succeeded in burning Hu Sha alive, but Hu Sha was rescued by Battle Brady and Socko Swenski who tracked down Manchuria Mary again. When Mary and her minions were taken prisoner again, Hu Sha kissed Battle again for saving her life.

hu ri.name: Hu-Ri
hu ri.origin: thumb|left|Undercover as Harry Charles Hu-Ri was a member of Wakandan Dora Milaje during the 1930s. As part of their mission to guard and protect the M'kraan Crystal inside the Temple of Inanna in Uruk, Babylon, she was send by the current Wakandan King on an undercover assignment to Siracusa, Sicily as pilot Harry Charles. To interfere with the ongoing Sixth Excavation of Babylon by the Nazi Party, the Wakandans joined with the other Allied powers in order to keep the M'kraan Crystal out of the Nazi hands, and other undercover Wakandans arranged for "Harry" to pilot Peter Parker and Dr. Huma Bergmann to Berlin. In Berlin they made contact with American agent Byron Ironsides, who directed them to Istanbul. "Harry" flew the pair to the Turkish capital, where they were joined by another agent codenamed "Checkpoint Red". The four of them proceeded to Uruk, where Huma was revealed to be allied with the Nazis, forcing Hu-Ri to reveal herself as a Wakandan. With the help of Ironsides she, along with Red and Spider-Man, was able to escape the Nazi ambush and together they proceeded inside the Temple of Inanna. Only one of the Dora Milaje could open the door to the Tomb of Heaven and the M'kraan Crystal, which Huma accomplished by having Electro attack them. Electro threw Hu-Ri and the Cicada Stone at the door and the Stone's energies opened it and exposed the way to the Underworld itself. The energies of the Cicada Stone in proximity of the M'kraan Crystal briefly changed Hu-Ri and Parker into spider-like forms, but the effects quickly wore off. Huma Bergmann revealed herself to be the Goddess Inanna in the flesh and Hu-Ri and Checkpoint Red attempted to distract her to no success. However, Spider-Man was able to connect the Cicada Stone to the M'kraan Crystal, weakening its structure, after which one well-placed shot destroyed it along with Inanna. Parker, Hu-Ri and Checkpoint Red were later extracted out of Babylon by Ironsides.

hua mulan.name: Hua Mulan
hua mulan.origin: Little is detailed about Hua Mulan's life before Dreadpool began murdering the inhabitants of the Ideaverse, however it can be presumed that it followed much the same path as Hua Mulan from the ballad . Using H.G. Wells' Time Machine, Sherlock Holmes recruited Hua Mulan, alongside Beowulf, Natty Bumppo, and Dr. Watson to help stop Dreadpool from destroying the Ideaverse. Holmes and his allies discovered the chaos left in Dreadpool's wake on the Island of Doctor Moreau, 1896, Lilliput, 1699, and Rome, 44 B.C.. Sherlock's allies eventually met up with Dreadpool and Frankenstein's Monster in Paris, 1627, after they had slain the Three Musketeers. Mulan had Natty Bumppo thrown onto her sword, which seemingly killed him. Later in the battle, as Dreadpool tried to escape, she cut off the hand with his teleporter.

huang zhu.name: Huang Zhu
huang zhu.origin: Huang Zhu was with the nationalists in China during it's civil war, after which he joined Hydra. The Warlord committed genocide on the Mnnzz' Guthir tribe, exterminating them all except for Princess Xantia. Taking their land, he established his base of operations in an ancient temple complex which had been built by the Eternals. In Hydra's opium fields were genetically-engineered "super-poppies". He organized a martial arts tournament, inviting martial artists from around the world to participate, in what they soon learned were death matches. On the night of the tournament, S.H.I.E.L.D. attacked his operation. Xantia took advantage of the opportunity and killed the Warlord, meanwhile SHIELD burned the opium fields.
abilities: Swordsmanship, Leadership

hubert hoopler.name: Hubert Hoopler
hubert hoopler.origin: Hubert Hoopler was an industrialist who came into contact with Juniper Fields, an inventor who had created a compound that could enhance the memory of anyone who drank it. Fields proposed to sell Hoopler the formula for a million dollars, and Hoopler, gripped by greed, said he was willing to buy it from him but he had to leave him the bottle. Fields accepted because it was impossible to reproduce the mixture without his instructions, but in any case it was not what Hoopler thought of doing. As soon as Fields left his office, Hoopler drank all the contents of the bottle and his memory grew disproportionately, in fact his idea was to destroy the formula so that he would be the most intelligent person and with his intelligence earn money. So the next day, Hoopler gave the agreed upon to Fields asking for the guarantee that he would not reveal the formula to anyone, and Fields replied that he did not have to worry because with the money received he intended to retire to a desert island far from everyone. Hoopler then, as soon as Fields left, destroyed the formula and called the board of directors of a company that he intended to scale and by churning out his new eloquence he amazed those present but suddenly he felt something in his brain and immediately his intellectual abilities plummeted. Shocked by what had happened he returned to his office and took back the bottle from which he had drunk and saw that under the bottle there was a sticker that he had not noticed before and that it was written that the serum lasted 24 hours and to keep a refill on hand. Adding insult to injury, because in addition to the knowledge he had acquired with the serum, his natural knowledge had also gone, making him as intellectually capable as an elementary school child.

hubert meese.name: Hubert Meese
hubert meese.origin: Hubert Meese was a man who employed Ms. Kelman as his secretary. During a work session, Meese dictated a letter and then asked Kelman to read it back to him. Instead of responding normally, she suddenly appeared dazed and unresponsive for several moments before abruptly flying into a violent rage. Without warning, Ms. Kelman lashed out and kicked Meese in the face while screaming that she hated him. Neither Meese nor Kelman realized that her behavior was the result of a wave of demonic influence affecting people across the country at the time.
