ian wajler.name: Ian Wajler
ian wajler.origin: ===Origin=== Ian Wajler became a human cybernetic technopath after developing the very advanced remote servo-technology called Mainframe for Cybertek Systems, Inc., the applied cybernetics division owned by Roxxon Oil Corporation where he worked as a private contractor. Wajler's brain was implanted with the Mainframe technology, and he was outfitted with state-of-the-art gear, after which he adopted Mainframe as his own nom de guerre. As a contractor, Mainframe also developed and performed field tests of heavy armaments in the robotics and cybernetics department of Cybertek. thumb|right|In civilian clothes Mainframe was called when Cybertek's important venture, the super-soldier cyborg Deathlok, turned rogue and left escaped the company. Cybertek's Division Head Harlan Ryker's men tracked the fugitive weapon Deathlok to a Jesus Badalemente's home in Coney Island, near the amusement park. Ryker provided Mainframe with a team of agents equipped with Terminal Armor, Dragonfly flying vehicles and the SQ1 submarine, along with a van from which Mainframe coordinated the operation. Although Ryker wanted the public to not be aware of the operation, Mainframe staged a spectacular attack in a full-of-people amusement park, his concession to the orders being trying to kill journalists on site. However, Deathlok saved many lives and, along with Badalamente who grabbed a discarded high-tech rifle, destroyed Mainframe's weapons. After his failure, Mainframe was apprehended by the police and sent to the maximum security prison of supervillains the Vault, although Cybertek covered up their involvement. Soon afterward, however, Ryker's and Cybertek's illegal dealings were proved, and Cybertek was disbanded, with many of their assets and designs ending up in the hands of criminal organization AIM. ===Alliance with Ben Jacobs=== Mainframe spent months in the Vault, honing his skills in seizing control of the security systems in order to escape. He also contacted Ben Jacobs, a former weapons designer for Cybertek who had worked on the Deathlok project and who, like Mainframe, had been defeated and humiliated by Deathlok, to propose him an alliance. Jacobs couldn't move his legs and had only one arm, so Mainframe tempted him by offering him technology that would allow him to walk and use two hands, in exchange for Jacobs modifying the Mainframe's cybercontrol circuitry. Eventually, Mainframe escaped from prison (although Deathlok was monitoring activities related to him and his other enemies, and was informed immediately), and met with Jacobs in an abandoned Brooklyn warehouse to give Jacobs his new armor. Mainframe convinced Jacobs to control Deathlok's actions between the two of them (Mainframe provided cybercontrol technology, and Jacobs modified it so it could override Deathlok's operating system), and then rent Deathlok out for money. Jacobs temporarily agreed, making it clear that he wanted to finish off Deathlok afterwards. thumb|left|Controlling a Guardsman to escape the Vault Mainframe knew that Deathlok was hiding out at Badalemente's, who worked making props for the Coney Island amusement park. Mainframe used his powers to control an animatronics dinosaur and turn it into a threat, and later did the same with a crane, with which he attacked Deathlok without caring about collateral damage. Deathlok found Mainframe and Jacobs, and tried to go after them, but when he came within Mainframe's range, Mainframe controlled Deathlok's technology and immobilized him long enough for Jacobs to insert a disk into Deathlok that would place Deathlok under Mainframe's control. Jacobs and Mainframe then attacked AIM Research Facility #13 in Stamford, Connecticut, with Mainframe in the rear controlling Deathlok's movements, and Jacobs wearing even larger armor with heavy weaponry. Mainframe wanted to get advanced designs and technology that AIM had, and Jacobs wanted to take the opportunity to get back at AIM for a previous offense. The attack was so brutal that the authorities (police, SWAT and Army Reserve) felt overwhelmed and did not intervene. During the attack, Mainframe observed that Deathlok did not use lethal force because Deathlok's organic brain, Michael Collins, had installed a "no killing" parameter in his software; Mainframe attempted to remove it, but Collins confronted Mainframe in cyberspace to stop him, and Collins eventually prevailed, regaining control of the cyborg and ejecting the disk from his arm. Jacobs, seeing the problem, attempted to deal with Deathlok by physically destroying him, and in the process pushed Mainframe to the ground and injured his arm; meanwhile, the Army intervened, seeing that Deathlok was facing the other enemies. Mainframe however wanted to stop Jacobs from harming the cyborg because Mainframe hoped to regain control over Deathlok, but Jacobs was dominated by his thirst for revenge; therefore, Mainframe, seeing the operation ruined, controlled Jacobs' armor with his powers and forced him
weaknesses: While muscular in appearance, Mainframe is a poor fighter. During the fight in Stamford, he was injured in his arm when his own ally Ben Jacobs carelessly pushed him.

fields.personality: A mercenary working for the higher bidder, Mainframe cares little for collateral damage, including innocent people who may be hurt directly during his operations He does care for his reputation and is unlikely to go back on his word: When arrested while working for Silvermane, Mainframe refused to collaborate with the authorities. He is also proud of his technological achievements and of the potential profit that could be achieved even if the item itself is immoral.
weaknesses: While muscular in appearance, Mainframe is a poor fighter. During the fight in Stamford, he was injured in his arm when his own ally Ben Jacobs carelessly pushed him.
transportation: While working for Cybertek Systems, Inc., he was provided a van to move around, as well as the SQ 1 Deep Sea Attack Craft, while on missions. Working in the Paris base, he used a hovering platform with a force field to move around.
fields.notes: In Spider-Man: Power of Terror #3, Mainframe tells Deathlok "I told you I'd control your destiny again." This seems to be a reference to Deathlok Vol. 2 #8, where Mainframe controlled Deathlok, then Deathlok recovered and Mainframe said that "I could've gotten back in!" (referring to Deathlok's operating system) - but Deathlok was not in hearing range when Mainframe said this. During the Paris operation, Mainframe did not talk directly to Deathlok.
fields.trivia: Mainframe is explicitly called "Mr. Wajler" (by his employer Ryker), meaning that Wajler does not have a PhD - otherwise, Ryker would have known and called him Dr., as with some of his other employees. Ian Wajler smokes cigarettes.

iann 23.name: Iann-23
iann 23.origin: Huntarr was once a young man named Iann-23, subjected to Karza's experiments which made his body incredibly metamorphic. He was dispatched to attack the Micronauts on behalf of Force Commander, who Karza was possessing at the time. He almost killed Princess Mari in her attempt to reach Force Commander, but Mari sensed Huntarr's confusion and sadness and convinced him he could find peace of mind by joining the Micronauts. Huntarr travelled with them for a short time, unsure of himself as he had family on Homeworld. But after a side trip to Homeworld, and witnessing the tragic suicide of both his mother and sister, he returned to the Micronauts' welcome. Huntarr sacrificed himself along with the rest of the Micronauts in order to restore life through the Microverse. While several Micronauts have resurfaced, Huntarr has not.

iao thamungazoth.origin: Iao-Thamungazoth was one of the Lords of Chaos and Lords of Darkness worshiped by the Dragon Kings of Lemuria, half a million years ago. They offered him sacrifice to feed their growing power. When the adventurers Sharjsha, Sumia Chond, and Karm Karvus came to the Castle of the Dragon Kings, on the four Dragon Isles of the inland Sea of Neol-Shendis, Sssaaa, High Priest of the Dragon Kings intended to sacrifice the three of them to the Lord of Chaos at the Altar of the Monoliths, to provide them the life-energies they required to cross the intercosmic gulfs to Earth. As the hour of the equinox came, Sssaaa was about to perform the sacrifice before the Lords of Chaos, whose faces appeared in the sky. The ceremony was interrupted by Thongor, who was soon assisted by Father Gorm who stroke down all the Dragon Kings.

iarbonel.name: Iarbonel
iarbonel.species: Forebearer of the Tuatha de Danaan
iarbonel.origin: ===Origins=== Iarbonel was a high chieftain who fathered the first generation of Tuatha de Danaan after mating with Danu, the name by which the Tuatha knew the primordial Earth Mother, Gaea. Among their children were Nuada, the Dagda, Leir, Badb, Macha, Morrigan, Ogma, and Ériu. ===Tuatha's Father=== Iarbonel and his offspring resided in Tír na nÓg, a realm within the Otherworld, while some of the Tuatha inhabited the underworld of Annwn. During their time in Tír na nÓg, his sons ruled at least two of the four great cities of the Tuatha de Danann: The Dagda governed Murias, while Nuada ruled over Finias. ===Death=== Following Iarbonel’s death, Nuada assumed leadership of the Tuatha de Danann. Around 1896 BC, the Tuatha departed their cities and traveled through an interdimensional nexus to Earth, arriving on the Irish mainland.

iblis.name: Iblis
iblis.origin: Iblis was an angel living in Heaven. According to unconfirmed sources, Iblis became a fallen angel, cast out of Heaven, presuambly for participating in Lucifer's rebellion. She self-styled as the Mother of Djinns and Demons. During the mystical adventure of the Fantastic Four in the world of Sinbad, during their 3rd Voyage, they infiltrated her temple to acquire the Mallet of Destiny. Managing to make eye-contact with Reed Richards, Susan and Johnny Storm, turning them into demonic forms, with Reed and Sue petrified into statues. Ben Grimm and Johnny managed to expose her to sunlight (Ben tore apart the roof and held it over himself, while Johnny fused the catacombs' walls into mirrors), causing her to turn in stone while cursing the House of Sinbad.
powers: By making contact with someone, Iblis could take control of their body and soul, shape them into demonic forms, and petrify them into statues. Those effects were reverted when Iblis was turned in stone.
weaknesses: Sunlight Weakness: When exposed to sunlight, Iblis turned to stone, which nullified the effects of her powers on others.

ichabod.name: Ichabod
ichabod.origin: Ichabod was the horse ridden by Matthew Masters, a doctor during the days of the American Frontier. Masters was previously a youthful outlaw known as the Cactus Kid. He was convinced by the Governor of Texas to swear off violence and killing to study and become a doctor. At sometime during his adult years, Matthews purchased Ichabod who was more or less a tame horse. However, when Masters developed the masked identity of the Black Rider, a heroic gunfighter devoted to fighting lawlessness in the west, he took to riding Ichabod -- calling him Satan during his adventures -- and the horse would prove to be as daring and gallant as his master when he was masquerading as the Black Rider. For the most part, either as Ichabod or Satan, the horse usually rode Matthew Masters or his alter ego the Black Rider around the region. However, the highly intelligent horse often helped the Black Rider during some of his adventures. Such as when Masters came across horse rustler Brush Bennett trying to steal the Lathrop's cattle. Matthew was grazed across the brow with a bullet, knocking him out and Satan rode him safety. Later when Bennett had captured the Black Rider, Satan came to his master's rescue, trampling Bennett to death. Later, when outlaw Tod Sultan briefly posed as the Black Rider, he attempted to use Satan to escape from Matthew Masters. Instead of riding away with the impostor, Satan bucket the outlaw off his back sending him falling off a cliff to his death. Satan more frequently came to his master's aid, saving him from trouble such as when both the Black Rider and Marie Lathrop found themselves prisoner of the mad scientist Professor Chalis, Satan chewed through their bonds so that they could escape. When they were attacked by Chalis' assistant, a giant named Zugg, Satan killed him with a blow to the head. Later, while the Black Rider was investigating a human smuggling operation that brought illegal Mexican immigrants into the United States, the ringleader Senior Morales got the drop on the Black Rider. However, the villain made the mistake of trying to mount Satan who simply bucked Morales off his back, sending the smuggler falling down a cliff to his death. When the Black Rider was assisting in the hunt for a puma that was stalking the Lathrop ranch, he shot the big cat before it could attack Marie. When the wounded beast tried to attack again, it met its end under Satan's trampling hooves. When the Black Rider exposed Marie's cousin Oscar Tippitt as the mastermind behind a bank robbery, the hero found himself locked in a hotel room while Tippitt attempted to flee town. Satan came to his master's aid by kicking down the door and the pair caught up with Tippitt as Matthew Masters and Ichabod and apprehended him. Eventually, the Black Rider moved on from Leadville, becoming a frontier doctor taking Satan with him. Satan took Masters to such places as: La Muerto, New Mexico; Edgeville; Gladwin Junction; Pass of the Needle; Brimstone City; Brimstone desert; Aspen Creek; Yellow Bluff; Hot Strike, Nevada; Crippled Bend, Colorado; Tombstone; Fort Noble, Montana; Locus Glen; Flat City, Wyoming; and Hope City. However, faithful as ever Ichabod accompanied his master when he eventually returned to Leadville to resume his practice there. But Ichabod/Satan still took his master to such locations as Santo Del Oro, Mexico; Doom Road; San Juan; Bedlam; El Dorado; Sonora, Mexico; Mule Messa; and Los Pintos.
abilities: Satan is a highly intelligent horse and has been trained by the Black Rider to follow simple commands. The horse is very intuitive and has often acted on his own to rescue his master from danger.

ichabod rasputin.name: Ichabod Rasputin
ichabod rasputin.origin: Angered at the world which mocked magic and the occult practices that he loved, Ichabod Rasputin used the magic of the Tavistick and animated the gigantic statue Fangor in New York City. Unfortunately, he was unable to control Fangor and he ran amok. Iron Man battled and defeated Fangor. In the ensuing battle the Tavistick was destroyed. Dejected, and despite some kind words from Dr. Strange on his belief in magic, Rasputin appeared to abandon his work in the occult.

ichiro hazaki.name: Ichiro Hazaki
ichiro hazaki.origin: Ichiro Hazaki, better known as the Bonsai Master, was an influential Japanese political figure. He sought to control the future of Japan for backing both leading candidates for the post of the Prime Minister, Itaru Ozu and Shinji Yokohama, while keeping the secret from both of them. Shinji asked the Bonsai Master to get rid of his candidate Ken Takahara, whose platform was too progress and threatened the traditional ways. The Bonsai Master hired the Rooster of the Yakuza to arrange the hit and tasked General Kato with gettind rid of the hitman at the same time. The men send by the General were eventually found dead, as was another group send in their wake. Panicking about his own fate, Kato went to talk to the Bonsai Master, who assured him that the situation was under control. On the night of the election, the Bonsai Master was targeted by Hit-Monkey. The Monkey went through the Bonsai Master's security forces before eventually confronting him in a katana duel. The Bonsai Master managed to inflict several surface wounds, but the Monkey ended up beating him. Shamed by defeat, the Bonsai Master committed seppuku.
abilities: Master Swordsman

ideal.origin: The Ideal was part of a group called the Adaptoids, a strike force who act on behalf of the Descendants, the robot people of the Core, led by the ominous Father. However, the Ideal also maintained a human identity as "Dr Leivan", a doctor in New York City. The Adaptoids were deployed to rescue Yalda, a Pakistani woman with Descendant heritage. Father and the Adaptoids raided A.I.M. Island in order to liberate a Stark Sentinel from A.I.M.. Just as they succeeded in their plan, they were confronted by the Avengers who also came there to take the Sentinel since it had secret files on every superheroes strengths and weaknesses. thumb|left|250px|The Ideal vs Captain America This led to a battle between the two groups with the Ideal targeting Captain America, after the latter through his shield at Ideal's teammate The Swine to knock him off balance. Ideal kept Cap at bay by smashing his fists against the shield. After gaining the upper hand. The Idea's body was suddenly shut down from an neural inhibitor created by Giant-Man in order to stop them in their tracks, but was considered by Vision as the equivalent of killing them.

idi amin.name: Idi Amin
idi amin.origin: ===Preface=== The past history of Idi Amin of Earth-616 likely mirrors that of his . The purpose of this article is to document activities that a unique to the Earth-616 universe. Appearances of Amin in the Modern Age should be considered topical references per the Sliding Timescale of Earth-616. Idi Amin was president of Uganda from 1971 to 1979 and was infamous for his various human rights violations, political repression, ethnic persecution, among other crimes. His attempts to annex the Kagera province of Tanzania in 1978 led to the . The conflict was an utter failure to Amin who then fled to Libya where he remained in exile until his death in 2003. ===Apocryphal Appearances=== Amin was depicted as the President of Uganda when Kinji Obatu convinced the president that he could raise Uganda's profile on the world stage by kidnapping prominent African-Americans and forcing them to live in his country. Utilizing the skills of voodoo practitioner W'Sulli, Obatu made good his promise and also managed to kidnap the Black Panther as well. Obatu took his prisoners to Amin's government residence in Kampala, and Amin received him open-armed, also witnessing a voodoo ceremony where W'Sulli took over the prisoners' minds. This plot was thwarted by the combined efforts of the Thing and Brother Voodoo, who sneaked into Uganda; fearing for his own safety, Amin drove away, leaving Obatu and W'Sulli behind. Both Obatu and W'Sulli were killed by their own agent, Nightspawn; and afterward the heroes left with their prisoners, believing that not even Amin would dare to attract attention to the Thing entering his country, because he'd also have to explain about the men Obatu had kidnapped from the United States.

fields.notes: thumb|left|Idi Amin (upper left) is hinted to be a demon. This is a fictionalized version of , a real historical figure. Idi Amin's face was shown in the art of while Belathauzer explained how members of his demonic race already roam Earth disguised as humans in order to sow discord and create chaos, implying that Idi Amin is secretly a demon. It is unclear if this is actually the case. , Tanzania's profile, mentions how Uganda tried to annex the Kagera province of Tanzania and this led to a war. It does not mention explicitly Amin's involvement or the consequences for him. In , Obatu addresses Amin as "Sir". This is not the appropriate protocol; Amin was to be addressed as "His Excellency". It's unlikely for Obatu to make that blunder: Having been a Minister under Amin, Obatu is expected to know these details. On a related note, in , Obatu ambitions the position of Prime Minister of his country (then unspecified, but later be stated as Uganda in ); and in Marvel Two-In-One #41, Amin is identified as the Prime Minister of Uganda. However, the position of Prime Minister had been abolished from 1966 to 1980, during Amin's dictatorship. Amin was not Prime Minister, but President for Life (as well as a number of other titles, none of them being Prime Minister). (2004), in two appendix entries (Nightspawn and Kinji Obatu), initially retcons the events told in (1978), where part of the plot takes place in Uganda and features historical then-President Idi Amin. Due to the Sliding Timescale, Amin's appearance should be consider a Topical Reference, as Amin historically was deposed in 1979 and died in 2003. The Encyclopedia instad replaces Amin with fictional African dictator Eda Arul and Uganda with fictional country Imaya (both seen mainly in ). However, later sources have disregarded this retcon and instead modified the continuity again so that the events in Marvel Two-In-One #41 take place in Uganda, only with an unnamed ruler instead of Amin. Specifically: Brother Voodoo's profile in both (2005) and (2008) both mention Obatu's escape to "a small African nation bordering Uganda", as had been stated in Marvel Two-In-One #41 because he escaped from Uganda. Imaya, per , borders only Niger and Nigeria. The Squadron Sinister's profile in (2006) and (2009) do not specify Obatu's country, just stating "his native country". Doctor Spectrum's profile in (2011) explicitly states that Obutu was deported to Uganda, and also that Uganda is his native country. References to the Ugandan president's name were omitted, just saying "the Ugandan president".
fields.trivia: Obatu was wary of Amin, thinking Amin was unpredictable and erratic. W'Sulli reassured Obatu, believing that this was merely Amin's public persona. Still, Obatu had met Amin in person, while W'Sulli had not.

idol yimshan.name: Idol (Yimshan)
idol yimshan.origin: Having been sent by a Messantian collector, Conan of Cimmeria fought fiercely against the Acolytes of Yimsha to obtain the Idol, hiding it beneath a cloth as he took it aboard a merchant ship. Unfortunately, Thoth-Amon became aware of the idol, and sent Black Corsairs to raid the merchant ship and retrieve it. Conan fought valiantly against the pirates but, when a pirate's blood reached the idol, it suddenly transformed, killing all on the ship but for Conan himself. Conan eventually killed the beast, causing it to burst into flames, almost destroying the ship it was on.
powers: When provided with blood, the idol revealed its true form as a giant tentacled creature. Corruption: Anything that consumed the flesh of the idol's victims became like the idol, growing in size and sprouting tentacles.

idomeneus.name: Idomeneus
idomeneus.origin: ===Early years=== Idomeneus was the warrior-king of Crete. He was one of the many suitors of Helen, and so was bound to an oath of loyalty towards Menelaus, whom Helen had chosen for husband. Idomeneus possibly had a son, Orsilochus, though Orsilochus might be a made-up person created by Odysseus. ===Trojan War=== Therefore, he joined the Trojan War when Paris, son of Priam, king of Troy stole Helen. He battled the Amazons of Penthesileia, killing Bremusa. When Odysseus and Ajax both claimed the armor of fallen Achilles, offered by his mother Thetis to the one that had retrieved his body, Ajax proposed to let Agamemnon, Nestor and Idomeneus judge. As Nestor highlighted that the loser would be wrathful towards the judge, Agamemnon gave the task to high-born Trojan prisoners, who designated Odysseus as the winner.
weapons: Spear.

ieyasu imura.name: Ieyasu Imura
ieyasu imura.origin: Sam Imura was framed for a murder he had not committed, sentenced to life sentence, and sent to serve in Alcatraz Island prison. Consumed by rage and hatred, he swore revenge on the people who had unjustly condemned him. Twenty years ago (see Notes), he escaped from prison by swimming and had a revelation when he was close to drowning, prompting him to abandon his negative emotions and instead help others, using the methods of criminals against the criminals. Although authorities left him for dead in the escape attempt, Imura actually joined the Dragon Clan, a group affiliated with the Yakuza who, unlike most of them, rejected organized crime activities to follow the clan's original precepts and protect the defenseless against those who would take advantage of them, including other Yakuza groups if if necessary. Becoming the oyabun of the Clan, Imura had the authority to give orders to all other members. After Alcatraz was no longer used as a prison, Imura built a secret base for the Dragon Clan hidden under the Alcatraz facilities, with clear inspiration from Japanese culture and architecture. Imura recruited Lieutenant Sabrina "Bree" Morrel, homicide detective of the San Francisco Police Department, who felt the need to help others but found that the law restricted her too much, and through Imura she saw how to help without jurisdiction and take advantage of an unofficial occupation. Becoming a samurai, she kept in close contact with Imura, whom she considered her sensei and lord (and she was even in love with him), although Imura often reproached Morell for his lack of patience. Morell attempted in vain to recruit construction worker David Ishima to the Clan, using Ishima's vehicle; possibly Ishima was inside at that time. Ishima's girlfriend, P.I. Jessica Drew, observed several indications linking Morell to the Yakuza, as Morell attempted to gain Drew's respect and trust to recruit her into the Clan, Morell also discovered that Drew was secretly the superhero Spider-Woman. Morell shared this last information only with Imura. Imura sent the Clan, except for Sabrina Morell, on a mission to Hawaii that Morell believed would include fighting. Morell believed that Imura had left her behind, much to her disappointment, because she was too impatient. After a tense situation in which Spider-Woman had asked Morell for help and Morell had been useless, Spider-Woman went to Morell's house to demand explanations. Morell, after a long day, arrived at her home and thought about the Clan, whispering that Imura had ordered her to not accompany the Clan on the mission; Spider-Woman revealed herself and told her that perhaps Imura, like herself, doubted that Morell was trustworthy. Spider-Woman accused Morell of being Yakuza. Morell told Spider-Woman that she was wrong, and Spider-Woman left, threatening to return if she found out that she had been tricked. Morell informed Imura as soon as possible of the threat that Spider-Woman was still loose posed to the Clan, although always highlighting Spider-Woman's virtues. Imura decided to keep an eye on Drew and Spider-Woman discreetly from his limousine, but Spider-Woman noticed how that vehicle appeared several times around her, and she pointed it out to Morell. Morell lied by telling Spider-Woman that she didn't know who she was, but she later informed Imura that surveillance of her was pointless. Imura and Morrel discovered that the would-be crimelord of San Francisco, General Nguyen Ngoc Coy, and the undisputed kingpin of the east coast, Wilson Fisk, had arranged a summit conference at the Carrilon Towers at a nearby date, and corrupt weapons manufacturing company Deterrence Research Corporation (DRC) intended to assassinate both, or at least one, to provoke a pan-country gang war and thus benefit from selling weapons. However, they had no evidence, nor the means to stop DRC on their own. Meanwhile, hit men possibly paid by Coy tried to kill Drew, but Morrel received a tip and rescued her; Drew and Ishima had been wounded before Morell arrived. Morell took Ishima to his home, leaving him in the care of Drew's roommate Lindsay McCabe, then took unconscious Drew to the Dragon Clan's secret base, where she cleaned and bandaged Drew's wound. When Drew woke up, Morrel opened up to her, introducing her to Imura and explaining that the Dragon Clan, while technically Yakuza, was trying to help people. Imura and Morrell told Drew that they knew her secret identity, but that they were not looking to blackmail her, instead asking for her help to save Coy and Kingpin; she agreed to help. Although Morrel wanted to keep the location of their base on Alcatraz a secret, Imura insisted that, as a sign of trust, they must reveal it to Drew, in exchange for Drew's own secret, her Spider-Woman identity. Spider-Woman effectively saved Coy and Kingpin from the attack, while Morrel oversaw the police aspect of the operation and searched for injuries. After that, Spider-Woman returned to Alcatra

Per the Sliding Timescale, Imura would not be old enough to have served time in Alcatraz: In (1982), he's said to have been sentenced to serve for life in Alcatraz and escaped "20 years ago", meaning approximately in 1962 at the time of publication. ignat karamazov.name: Ignat Karamazov
ignat karamazov.origin: Ignat and his brother Yuri were members of the Vladivostok Mafia, a Russian criminal gang that ran criminal operations in Madripoor. They once bought the legs and body of the android Elsie-Dee from Donald Pierce for cheap. They tinkered with the robotic parts so that it would serve drinks to customers at Club Azimut, an establishment run by the Vladivostok Mafia. Elsie-Dee and her partner Albert later broke into Club Azimut to retrieve Elsie-Dee's legs and body. After Albert dispatched the gang members at the club, including the Karamazov Brothers, he put Elsie-Dee back together. Before Elsie-Dee left with Albert, she broke Ignat's nose for what he did to her body. The Brothers and other members of the Vladivostok Mafia later organized to get revenge on Albert and Elsie-Dee. During the confrontation with the androids, Ignat used a RPG. After hitting Albert with a projectile, Ignat fired another, which was grabbed by Elsie-Dee and thrown back at him and Yuri. The projectile detonated, killing both brothers.

weapons: Guns, RPG

ignatius fowler.name: Ignatius Fowler
ignatius fowler.origin: Ignatius Fowler was an introverted child who lived a reclusive life, enjoying his studies and having no time for friends, playing, or romance, finding nothing more enjoyable than expanding his mind and learning all he could about nuclear physics. As a teenager, while most of his peers were out enjoying dances and dating, he stayed home and worked on scientific formulas. He graduated from College at age 16, earning the highest grades in the school's history. He used his expertise to earn a fortune and founded the Fowler Research Institute. There he continued his experiments in nuclear physics, and soon became renown as one of the greatest scientific minds of his generation. One day in 1948 he was alone in his lab when some thieves broke in, seeking to steal the valuable supply of Radium and Uranium in his lab, setting off the alarm. Ignatius was manhandled by the crooks who demanded he reveal where the isotopes where hidden when suddenly the Blonde Phantom came crashing in through a window. As the Blonde Phantom easily subdued the crooks, Ignatius found himself falling madly in love with the Blonde Phantom. After the police took the crooks away, Ignatius then proposed marriage to the heroine. Unable to help herself, the Blonde Phantom laughed at the proposal and then politely declined the offer. Filled with rage, Fowler vowed to make the Blonde Phantom his wife by making himself literally the last man on Earth. To this end, he created a "Mist of Sleep" out of a chemical compound and used remote control blimps to spread the mist all over the world. The mist caused all men on Earth, except for himself, to go into an eternal sleep. He then broadcast to the women of the world and informed them that unless the Blonde Phantom agreed to marry him, the men of Earth would remain in this perpetual state of sleep for the rest of their lives. Sure enough, a mob of women brought the Blonde Phantom to Fowler and he once more demanded that she marry him. Blonde Phantom then used her female charm to get Fowler to show her how he succeeded in putting the men of the world to sleep. Shown the antidote, Blonde Phantom then smashed open the chemical vat and filled a vial with the antidote and then locked herself in the hanger where Ignatius kept his blimps. Furious, Fowler led an army of women to knock down the door. When this failed, he planted a bomb, but before it could go off the Blonde Phantom unleashed the antidote waking all the men of Earth. The Blonde Phantom's ally Mark Mason and an army of men disarmed the bomb then freed the Blonde Phantom from the hanger. In the aftermath of the whole affair, Ignatius Fowler was committed to a mental institution for treatment. His subsequent fate is unknown.
abilities: Fowler was a brilliant nuclear physicist and chemist.

igneous.origin: Igneous was one of the surviving members of the Order of the Glorious End after the performance of a ritual that summoned the cosmic entity of Death. However, she was subsequently kidnapped. Death's disappearance made dying impossible across the entire universe. When Thanos and Deadpool investigated the disappearance of their mistress, they ended up in the base of the Order, the Dwindling Light. Igneous and the other remaining members of the Order engaged them in combat before discovering they also worshipped Death. The Order offered the two intruders all the information they could give in exchange for their deaths at the hands of Thanos as soon as Death was recovered. The Guardians of the Galaxy arrived to the Dwindling Light soon after, to track down Thanos, believing Death's disappearance to be his deed. The Order helped Thanos and Deadpool get the Guardians off their back until they could escape and continue their search.

igor russian spy.name: Igor (Russian Spy)
igor russian spy.origin: Igor and Stansky were sent by their superior to help the Black Widow use the Anti-Gravity Device against Tony Stark, Iron Man and Fort Knox. Iron Man found them a few minutes after they had arrived to Black Widow's hideout, and he easily took care of Stansky and Igor, causing them to escape in fear. They reunited with the Black Widow in the street after she incapacitated Iron Man. They travelled to Fort Knox, where Black Widow used the Anti-Gravity Device to make an entire mountain levitate. Stansky and Igor where rescued by Iron Man from the mountain when it fell, and they were subsequently arrested. Some time later, Igor and Georgi visited Rhino after he came out of jail, offering to restore and enhance his powers if he would aid them in capturing Bruce Banner for their superiors, who were hoping to unlock the secret behind the Hulk. During the subsequent attack near JFK Airport, thanks to interference by Rick Jones, Igor fell off the helicopter piloted by Georgi.

igor grozick.name: Igor Grozick
igor grozick.species: Human turned into a Bear with human intelligence by nuclear radiation
igor grozick.origin: Igor Grozick was a Soviet spy sent to discredit the United States. Grozick dressed up in a bear costume and approached American scientists at the site of a nuclear test, pretending to be a bear that had been given human intelligence and speech by the nuclear radiation. After becoming a scientific sensation, Grozick intended to reveal his deception in order to make Americans look foolish and gullible to the rest of the world, only to find, after removing the costume, that the radiation he had been exposed to at the test site had turned him into an actual talking bear. thumb|left|Before transformation Years later, Grozick returned, having been part of a group of 1960's era Soviet agents who had been put into cryogenic sleep in order to be woken up in the event of a nuclear attack on American soil. After an explosion set off by the Infernal Man off the California coast woke them up, Grozick and his fellow Super-Soldiers fought, and were defeated by, the Order.

igor korbeau.name: Igor Korbeau
igor korbeau.origin: In 1941, the mad scientist Dr. Igor Korbeau had invented a device that could remove the soul from the human body, making the still-living victim his slave. Once completing the device, he used it on Dr. Zadig, his greatest foe in the scientific community. He used Zadig to lure more prominent scientists to come and be converted into his slaves. Korbeau sent his army of slaves to steal equipment and murder all those who stood in his path so that he could continue and expand his operations. His activities attracted the attention of the extra-dimensional Vision, who considered the practice an affront to the natural order. Korbeau seemingly slayed the Vision by throwing a jar of poison gas on the hero before resuming his work. The Vision survived the attack and restored the souls of those who Korbeau converted by travelling to the afterlife to retrieve them. Returning to Earth, the Vision prevented Korbeau from turning the Chief of Police into one of his soulless thralls. During the fight, the police chief was fatally shot and the Vision injected with a tranquilizer administered by Korbeau. Korbeau attempted to run the same process on the Vision, but the hero broke free. In the ensuing struggle, he tossed the scientist out of a window, sending him falling to his death.
abilities: Korbeau was a skilled scientist and an inventive genius, albeit a mad one.
weapons: Korbeau armed himself with a pistol.

igor zetaxas.name: Igor Zetaxas
igor zetaxas.origin: Igor has ruled Belavia, a country that became a dictatorship in the 1940s, as a prelude to his goal of conquering the world. Ten years after he'd assumed power, he forced Hendrik Muir to help achieve his goal, keeping him imprisoned until the scientist agreed. Later, Hudrick pretended to use a machine that would turn Igor's soldiers invisible, when actually they were transported to another dimension. Igor realized too late that his soldiers were gone, and that he had been betrayed by the scientist. Afterwards, Zetaxas lost his power and Betavia was freed from his dictatorship.

igraine.name: Igraine
igraine.origin: ===Early Life=== Igraine was a sea-princess of Avalon, the largest surviving island of Atlantis, still flourishing eight thousand years after the Great Catastrophe. She was the daughter of the ancient priest of the sun, Amlawdd, birthed by Gwert, and the the sister of Duke Elise. 200px|left|thumb|Birth of Morgan Le Fay She married a man of the sacred clan, and birthed a daughter, Morgan Le Fay. As the custom went, Morgan was taken to be trained at the House of Virgins to serve as Avalon's sea-princess, the great sun temple of the Crystal City of the volcanic island of Ruta. The women were given in marriage to men of the sacred clan for magical purposes, forbidding Morgan the love she seeked. 250px|left|thumb|Escaping Avalon A young priest, Myraddin, was warned of the upcoming and long foretold catastrophe that was going to occur. The ancient priest of the sun entrusted Myraddin with his secret scrolls, and with his daughter Igraine. Myraddin and Igraine rushed to the House of Virgins where they took Morgan, and flew on a merchant ship from Tingail, while the remaining islands of Atlantis were drowned by great tidal waves caused by the burst of the volcano. ===Britain=== left|250px|thumb|Marriage to Gorlois, Duke of the Tintagel They ended up on the Isle of Britain, where Myraddin changed his name to Merlin and established his druid worship in Stonehenge. He arranged for Igraine to marry Gorlois, Duke of the Tintagel, who adopted Morgan. Gorlois was killed by Uther Pendragon, who took Igraine for queen. She birthed a son, Arthur. Growing into a fine young woman, Morgan followed Merlin to Aran Island to become his apprentice, in exchange for also becoming his lover, but failed on her pledge. Eventually, Morgan opposed to Merlin and Arthur, and was imprisoned by Merlin in Castle Le Fey. ===Legacy=== A jewel Igraine once owned became known as the Eye of Igraine, and allowed the summoning of Morgan.

ikeda honda.name: Ikeda Honda
ikeda honda.origin: Ikeda's son Seiji was a developmentally disabled and telekinetic mutant. She tried to make her son stop from using his powers, fearing that his nature would be revealed to their relatives. At some point, she marry Noboru, who revealed to be a monstrous stepfather and husband, beating his mother Ikeda. When Noboru found out about the mutant powers of his step-son and intended to sell Seiji to the government, Ikeda tried to stop him, Noboru threatened her. In order to save his mother's life, Seiji animated all of his action figures at once and send them on his cruel stepfather. This proved insufficient to stop Noboru, who cornered the boy on the balcony of their apartment. Noboru made a desperate lunge, and he and Seiji fell over the edge. The fall killed Noboru and left Seiji paralyzed from the neck down, and Ikeda alone.

iko akakowa.name: Iko Akakowa
iko akakowa.origin: The Serpent was a member of the Imperial Japanese army during World War II. He was known for the poison glands under his fingernails that he used to slay his victims. In the spring of 1943, Emperor Hirohito dispatched the Serpent to eliminate Chinese-American Ling Toy who had heard the last broadcast of her boyfriend, Chinese fighter pilot Ching Wing, which hinted at a secret underground tunnel between Japan and the United States being built on Shoto Island. The Serpent was opposed by the Young Allies who also heard the broadcast and came to Ling Toy's aid. Chased across the United States, China, and Japan, the Young Allies were followed relentlessly by the Serpent. When the underground tunnel was discovered, the Young Allies rushed after the Serpent as he attempted to make his way to America to begin an invasion. The Young Allies fought and defeated the Serpent. Shamed by his defeat, he then scratched his own face lethally poisoning himself in an act of Soppiku. The Young Allies destroyed the tunnel shortly thereafter.

ilija knezevic.name: Ilija Knezevic
ilija knezevic.origin: When he was a kid, Ilija Knezevic's cousin and uncle were attacked by Red Room operative Natasha Romanova. Ilija's uncle died, his cousin barely made it out alive, and Ilija was uninjured due to Romanova having failed to notice him sleeping in the back seats of the car they were driving at the time of the attack. As they reached adulthood, Ilija and his cousin took over his uncle's criminal operations. Knezevic became an intelligence gatherer, using his telepathic abilities to mine secrets from the minds of his victims with blackmailing purposes. He became the man behind the curtain while his cousin was the face and muscle of the operation, known as Platch Liev. They also investigated the killer of Ilija's uncle, who had grown up to become the Avenger Black Widow. When Ilija found the former Headmistress of the Red Room to be out of his reach, he retrieved numerous compromising records about Black Widow and had his brother abduct her and subsequently blackmail her into obtaining the details of the Headmistress' new terrorist program known as the Dark Room. After she retrieved the files, Knezevic had her go to a transfer zone to have a courier retrieve them. When the files were destroyed as a consequence of the intervention of S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Elder, Platch Liev proceeded to broadcast the secrets of Black Widow's records through every media outlet possible. While on the run, Black Widow managed to access the Parisian offices of Tony Stark and track down a serial number she had memorized of a Stark Industries shipping crate from Platch Liev's hideout. Now armed and ready, she traveled to the serial number's address, and confronted and subdued Ilija's brother. Ilija's revealed himself as the "true" Platch Liev in order to prevent Black Widow from killing his brother. Even though there were no other compromising records on the Black Widow, Ilija threatened to use his telepathic abilities to dig information directly from Black Widow's mind. illa.name: Illa
illa.first_appearance: Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur Vol 1 19
illa.origin: Illa is a Genius Loci and, as a small moon in his orbit, the "daughter" of Ego the Living Planet. While working on a fourth grade science project about Earth's Moon, Lunella Lafayette set up a Translation Helmet communication array on the roof of the highest point of Manhattan's Lower East Side. This allowed her to receive a deep space distress call from an alien girl who claimed to have been separated from her father and was lost and alone. Lunella then created an interstellar craft, powered by the Omni-Wave Projector, which helped her to manipulate space-time and pinpoint the origin of the signal. Crash landing on the moon where they believed Illa to be located, Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur used Environment Suits to explore the lunar surface while attempting to locate the missing child. Unable to lock on the source of the communique, Illa then revealed herself as the entire moon, happily proclaiming she had waited a lifetime for someone to find her.

fields.unusual_features: Illa is a moon. Although she has no actual eyes, she does appear to have two glowing protrusions that look like eyes.

illyana rasputina moira vii 1.name: Illyana Rasputina (Moira-VII.1)
illyana rasputina moira vii 1.origin: Magik was resurrected with her DNA tainted by Sinister. She eventually became a member of the Quiet Council, who gradually conquered the world, corrupting the entire planet's population. Using Sebastian Shaw's connections in the Infernal Parliament, Magik was able to borrow the Twilight Sword and used it to destroy the Bifrost, leaving Asgard drifting in space. Magik and the other council members managed to undo Sinister's top-level control imprints, granting them a greater level of self-determination. They defied their "creator", choosing to pursue war against the interstellar empires rather than focus on Sinister's goal of becoming a Dominion. Nearly 90 years later, the council had stamped out nearly all intergalactic opposition. In an effort to tie up loose ends, Magik once again attacked Asgard, this time destroying it completely. With their other rivals destroyed, the sinister-corrupted mutantkind became the dominant life forms in the galaxy. With no more external foes, they soon turned on each other. 900 years later they had splintered into nearly a million separate polities. At some point, Magik attempted to bring Limbo into normal reality, creating the Limbic Infernality. After her defeat in the 7th diamond war, Magik retreated to the Infernality.

illyena groitzig.name: Illyena Groitzig
illyena groitzig.origin: Illyena was the daughter of Wolfgang Groitzig, a scientist forced to construct the 'Doomsday weapon' by the Red Skull during World War II. As a young girl in the 1970s, Illyena overheard a conversation between her father and Richard and Mary Parker, who were American government spies sent to retrieve the Doomsday device. Richard and Mary knew that they wouldn't make it back to America alive, so they gave the details of the device to Groitzig, who kept them in his home for the next twenty years. As Illyena grew up, she kept her father hidden in the house, as he was assumed dead. She also married a man named Karl. Twenty years later, after her father had gone missing, Illyena was visited by American journalists Joe Robertson and Peter Parker, Richard and Mary's son. She revealed to them the hidden details of the Doomsday weapon, but the Chameleon arrived and stole them for the Kingpin.

ilmarinen.name: Ilmarinen
ilmarinen.origin: According to ancient myths, the first Sky Father Ilmarinen emerged from the extradimensional realm of Taivas and used his hammer to shatter the Cosmic Egg that predated all of existence, using its primordial contents to give shape to the physical world. He also used the contents of the Cosmic Egg to create lesser godlings who came to be known as the Jumala; however, it is unclear whether the Jumala race originated on Earth, Taivas, or in another dimension linked to Taivas. After forging the sky, sun and moon with his hammer, Ilmarinen chose to relinquish his role as Sky Father and live on Earth among mortals as a blacksmith. He was succeeded as Sky Father by his son, Ukko.

ilse.name: Ilse
ilse.species: Frost Giant of Valhal, she was made immortal by a wizard for her beauty and long golden hair.
ilse.origin: ===Origin=== Not much is known about Ilse before her capture from the Yeti-King, and eventual freedom and icy entombment. What is is that aeons before being freed by Conan, Ilse was Princess of the Frost Giants from Valhal of Vanadium. And one day, due to her beauty, the Great Wizard of the Ancient Forest cast a spell on her. Having made her immortal, and preserving her forever. The Wizard also cast the same spell upon fellow Frost Giant, Hanar, so he could keep her safe for all eternity. Some time later, and unbeknownst to Ilse, her beauty caught the attention of the Yeti-King (aka The Mountain King and King of the Top of the World). When she and Hanar became intimate, the Yeti-King sent his yeti warriors to kidnap her. Bring her to the Yeti-King's palace, situated high atop a mountain known as Top of the World, located north of Vendya. There, he forced Ilse to become one of his harem and lucked her away in his seraglio. Waiting for Hanar to save her, the aeons pasted, and both Ilse and the Yeti-King, were all that was left in a palace of corpses and vast treasures. During this time, Ilse came to hate Hanar. Believing he was off dawdling in mead halls and debauching in the purdah’s of the east, while she was kept in the King's harem. She would also come to believe that their immortality wasn't a gift. But a curse placed on them by the Wizard, and it was Hanar's fault for angering him. ===In The Hall Of The Mountain King=== thumb|left One day she found herself freed from the seraglio by Conan, Conan who with Hanar come to save her and Conan himself had killed the Yeti-King. Happy to be free she found Hanar pinned to a rock with a billet of iron through the chest from the kings ballista. As Hanar begged his beloved to free him, Ilas happily though misguided took her revenge on him by cutting his legs off and tell him all she came to feel towards him as well as laying to him about wanting to be taken by the Yeti-King. If she had stopped to listen to him, she would have learn that he had been looking for her and had become trapped in ice for all this time. But more then that that Hanar had learned from Conan their people of Valhal are long dead. thumb|right|262px She left Hanar there to free himself and the Mountain Kings Palace behind, with Conan as her guide she carried him with her. Still angry from her encounter with Hanar she carelessly ran through the snow covered mountain side ignoring Conan's warnings of the ice crevasses. True enough, they fell into an ice crevasse, where she became trapped. Having helped Canon down the mountain, she hoped he would free her. But as she became entombed, he left her to suffer the same fate as Hanar had.

ilse pterigil.name: Ilse Pterigil
ilse pterigil.origin: The Defenders encountered a being called the Star-Thief, who was responsible for making the stars disappear. The Beast deduced that the reason the Star-Thief has only been stealing stars and not entire galaxies must be because he came from a planet in a large interstellar dust cloud, where other galaxies are not visible. Finding a planetary system in such a cloud, the Defenders and aliens headed there, but an interstellar fleet intercepted them. The Star-Thief appeared and tried to destroy the Defenders, but Cloud absorbed its star bolt and realized that it cannot use its full power because they are close to Star-Thief's home, where its real body was. Star-Thief fled, and Cloud was able to track its energy. The Defenders made their way through a major city to its largest building, where the planet's Queen resided. The Queen's daughter, the Princess, has been in a coma ever since she was struck in the eyes by a laser beam. The Defenders realized that the Princess was the Star-Thief, who has been subconsciously making the stars disappear because their light reminded her of the laser that blinded her and made her afraid.

ilya dubromovitch skorzorki.name: Ilya Dubromovitch Skorzorki
ilya dubromovitch skorzorki.species: Human whose DNA was combined with a wolf (mutate)
ilya dubromovitch skorzorki.origin: thumb|left|150px|Human form Volk (Ilya Dubromovitch Skorzorki) was one of Russia's most deadly assassins and an exceptionally skilled tracker. During the Cold War, he was assigned to prevent nuclear arms designer Dimitri Suhkarov from defecting to the West with his daughter, Viktoria. Volk pursued the Sukharovs through the Ural Mountains with three soldiers, but Wolverine intervened and eliminated the soldiers. Volk eventually confronted Suhkarov and his daughter at a bridge over the Yenisei River, where Wolverine attacked him from behind. Despite Wolverine's intervention, Volk overpowered him and killed Suhkarov before allowing Wolverine and Viktoria to leave the country. Some time later, Volk became a test subject in a KGB experiment intended to create genetically enhanced agents. His DNA was combined with that of a wolf, granting him enhanced tracking abilities and the ability to transform into a werewolf-like creature at will. Following the fall of the Soviet Union, Volk became a freelance mercenary, accepting only assignments that offered him a sufficient challenge. A member of Operation: Zero Tolerance eventually hired Volk to assassinate Wolverine. Volk tracked Logan to a bar in New York City, where the two engaged in a vicious battle. As the fight progressed, Volk's appearance and behavior became increasingly wolf-like, apparently triggered by the adrenaline of combat. When Wolverine refused to continue playing his opponent's game, Volk murdered Logan's friend Bull Hosek and escaped, telling Wolverine that he would "take back" the gift he had once given him. Volk subsequently kidnapped Viktoria from her hotel suite and challenged Wolverine to meet him at the same bridge in Siberia where he had killed her father. During their final battle, Volk progressively transformed until he became completely wolf-like. Wolverine eventually realized that Volk had never truly intended to kill him. Instead, he had deliberately sought out increasingly dangerous fights in order to trigger his transformation and escape his human existence. After Volk completed his transformation, Wolverine stopped Viktoria from shooting him, allowing the wolf to flee into the wilderness.

fields.unusual_features: When transformed, Volk resembled an anthropomorphic wolf with white fur, claws, fangs, and a tail. Can also transform into something resembling a true wolf.

ilya koblev.name: Ilya Koblev
ilya koblev.origin: Ilya Koblev and his brothers Issa and Ioakim are a set of mutant triplets with cat-like powers known as the Snow Leopards. They were raised and trained by Professor Phobos in the Super-Soldier School. When the project was canceled, the three Leopards settled in Siberia, among the wild animals, where they were found by Yi Yang. Under her leadership, they fought with Night Raven and Black Widow and until Issa's death. Years later, after the M-Day Ilya and Ioakim kept their powers and joined the Remont 6. Together with the team they fought with the Winter Guard, but lost and were arrested.
powers: Claws and Fangs

imara.name: Imara
imara.origin: Imara was the daughter of a bar owner who lived in Murra, a small town in northern Nicaragua. Imara and the other villagers were struck by a curse due to the actions of Alejandra Jones, who became the Ghost Rider to save them and protected the village afterward, coming to be known as the Guardián Fantasma. Imara's village was attacked by the murderous Carnage, who wanted to collect the codex from the Rider so he could come closer to releasing the dark Elder God Knull. Imara and her family hid inside the bar until Daniel Ketch, another Ghost Rider, came looking for his female counterpart. Imara's father pulled out a double-barrel shotgun and pointed it at Ketch while asking whether he came to town with the monster, but he said that he was looking for their "Guardian," so Imara replied that she was up in the hills fighting against the symbiote. Ketch told everyone to find a place to hide while he went to go help out his fellow Rider, but Alejandra was killed by Carnage. As Imara headed downstairs into the basement to hide, she became possessed by Alejandra's spirit. "Imara" gathered her fellow villagers, rallying them and they began throwing Molotovs at Carnage, which resulted in him escaping on the top of a semi being driven by members of the Cult of Knull. While this transpired, Imara's soul struggled against Johnny Blaze, the ruler of Hell and another Ghost Rider, to return to her body. After Alejandra thanked Danny for helping to protect the town, she relinquished Imara's body, rendering the girl clueless to what had transpired. Ketch told her that their Guardian needed her help, but disappeared back to Hell; leaving Imara's town under the protection of Danny as their new guardian.
abilities: Imara spoke both Spanish and English.

imbalayo.name: Imbalayo
imbalayo.origin: Imbalayo was a Kushite, and the general of the Kushite Cavalry. As Stygia lacked men to sent to Asgalun, a city-state of Shem that they were attempted to control through the usurper King Nim-Karrak and were about to claim outright, they hired Imbalayo's mercenaries to act in their stead and quell the expected civil war that would ensue among the Shemite population in reaction to the annex. When a squad of Black Corsairs led by M'Gora went to Asgalun to spy on Bêlit (daughter of the usurped king and niece to Nim-Karrak, they met with Imbalayo and his Kushite Cavalry. Imbalayo gave them a choice between being slain on the spot for their weapons, and join their cavalry. As Nim-Karrak fled the city, and the Stygians effectively took control, intending to slay Nim-Karrak's cousin and potential next-in-line Uriaz, the various factions engaged in a massive battle. The Black Corsairs disguised as Kushites targeted the Hyrkanians (mercenaries hired by Nim-Karrak), forcing them to join the Shemites. Imbalayo seeing that the Stygians were the losing side, ordered his troops to cease fighting with Shemites and Hyrkanians, and rather turn on the few remaining Stygians, leading to their immediate surrender. Unwilling to rule, Bêlit immediately bestowed the crown upon Uriaz, reigniting riots between his supporters and exiled Akhîrom's, a brawl joined by the Hyrkanians and Kushites (while the Stygians, too few), while Akhîrom approached the city with an army. About three years later, the Hyrkanians of Mazdak were still a throat with Imbalayo's Kushite, with the Kushites attacking them in the streets at night.

imdugud.species: Angel degenerated into demon and rebirthed (metaphorically or literally) as an Annunaki, later degenerated back into a demon{{r|Marvel Zombies: The Book of Angels, Demons & Various Monstrosities Vol 1 1| & ; Pazuzu' profile}}
imdugud.origin: ===Origins=== The demons Pazuzu was apparently originally an angel, but was also stated to be the son of Hanbi/Hanpu,{{r|Marvel Zombies: The Book of Angels, Demons & Various Monstrosities Vol 1 1| & ; Pazuzu' profile}} Hanbi being the Sumerian name of Dormammu. His mother was possibly Aura, daughter of Apsu and Tiamat. His brothers included Galla, Imra, Lamma, Lulal, and Sedu.{{r|Marvel Zombies: The Book of Angels, Demons & Various Monstrosities Vol 1 1| & ; Pazuzu's profile}} ===War in Heaven=== Pazuzu was among the 14 angels that became Lucifer's chief lieutenants during his rebellion against Heaven.{{r|Marvel Zombies: The Book of Angels, Demons & Various Monstrosities Vol 1 1| & ; Pazuzu' profile}} At some point, Pazuzu prevented his fellow underworld demon-goddess, fallen angel, and hated rival Lamashtu from escaping Irkalla and travelling to Earth to threaten pregnant women and newborn babies. Long ago in ancient Mesopotamia or Sumer or someplace like that, priestesses of the demon Pazuzu, Bringer of Disease, were engaged in a religious war with the priests of the god Marduk or Baal or Dagon. Pazuzu granted one of his priestesses, Vicki of Humbabu, a jewel with the instructions: "Make a bracelet of purest uranium and wear this jewel on your wrist. You will develop vastly enlarged bazooms, and when the enemies strike you alone will be spared". The amulet Vicki made from the gem and uranium granted her the Doucheblade, which allowed her to slay all the priests when they attacked (although the rest of her priestesshood died, as prophesied by Pazuzu). As the Demon-Dragon Zu, he was bested by the team-up of Hercules and Gilgamesh. After Vicki of Humbabu died in the desert from radiation poisoning, the Blade was passed through the Pazuzu-chosen of their generation: Hatshepsut of Egypt, Hippolyta of the Amazons, Joan of Arc of France, the British writer Jane Austen, Queen Victoria of Britain and Eleanor Roosevelt the wife of President Franklin D. Roosevelt, then finally disappeared for forty years. ===Modern days=== The chosen of this generation was Detective Suzi Pazuzu.

imei chang.origin: Imei was a young Chinese woman, and the betrothed of Wong - servant to Sorcerer Supreme, Doctor Strange. For a time, she lived at Doctor Strange's Mansion in Greenwich Village, and was witness to many spectacular events. She developed a close friendship with Strange's assistant, Sara Wolfe. She was soon killed by the demon named Sister Nil and impersonated for a time by the demon Xaos as a part of Salome's scheme against Doctor Strange.

imhotep demon.name: Imhotep (Demon)
imhotep demon.origin: As prophesized by an old man, Imhotep and his hundred thousand brothers came one night to Bêcharadur, descending upon the city in a lightning-quick assault, completely destroying the city-state. Imhotep and his Sky-Horde appeared soon afterward over the great forest of Shem. Imhotep sent forth a destructive mist that stole the life from General Soto's soldiers, though Conan, who possessed a magical amulet, and Keiv, whom he held, were spared. Strengthened by the massive kill, Imhotep prepared to regain his freedom, but then his Sky-Horde abruptly fell from the air, and Imhotep's power waned again. He realized that though the amulet was the key to his escape from this world, its presence repulsed him, filling him with waves of fear and loathing. He vowed to someday overcome his fear of the amulet, gain his freedom, track down Pathir, and have his revenge before finally returning home. Seeing Conan as a rival, King Maddoc II sent him with untrained troops (prisoners released from the cells) to battle the savage M'Gai tribe. The battle broke up as the M'Gai leader, Kollos, on the verge of victory, fled upon sensing the approach of Imhotep. Imhotep alighted atop his winged steed, and Conan confronted him, driving him back with the amulet. Seeing this power, Kollos ambushed Conan, striking him from behind and stealing the amulet, after which Imhotep charged and then tackled Conan. Imhotep clashed swords with Conan, quickly putting the Cimmerian on the defensive. As Imhotep's horde approached from the sky, Conan's soldiers rallied to his aid, retaking the amulet. Meanwhile, Conan battled Imhotep fiercely, using his skill to hold off the vastly more powerful demon. When Imhotep became enraged at the time the battle was taking and the difficulty he was having in defeating a single mortal, Conan took advantage of the demon's careless and sliced him nearly in half with Imhotep's own sword. Imhotep collapsed and his horde fled into the sky; but when Shapur returned the amulet to Conan, Imhotep arose anew and snatched the amulet from his hands. Imhotep's contact with the amulet unleashed a burst of eldritch energy that forged an empathic bond between Imhotep and Conan such that Conan was the only one who could continue to see and hear him. Imhotep acknowledged that Conan was the first among humanity that he had found worthy of survival and that Conan was a noble being who had bested him. Telling Conan that he had broken his spirit, Imhotep knelt before him and told him he was forever his slave. Invisible to most, Imhotep was nonetheless seen by Keiv when Conan and his troops returned to El Shah Maddoc. The next morning, with Keiv and Imhotep at his side, Conan led the troops to assault Maddoc's castle. After a brutal battle, Conan slew Maddoc. Afterwards, "Tetra" confronted Conan, Keiv, and Imhotep, and Imhotep recognized her as Pathir; she suddenly blew up the entire castle. After Conan agreed to be her lover, Tetra transported Conan back to the castle and then followed his instruction to return Keiv back to his human form. Departing to return to his brothers in the void, Imhotep dropped Conan a short distance to the ground and told him that if they ever met again it would not be as allies. imir.species: Ice Giant deity, also considered a Demon, and progenitor of the Giants
imir.origin: ===Origin=== Ymir came to being in Niffleheim, one of the Ten Realms. He was the progenitor and the most powerful of the Ice Giants (Hrimthurs), a race from which the Giants of Jotunheim (among them Storm Giants, Mountain Giants, Rime Giants, and most notably the Frost Giants) descended. Like the other Ice Giants, Ymir was covered with snow and ice, and constantly generated intense coldness from his body. The huge size, durability, and colossal strength of the Ice Giants made them formidable foes to the gods of Asgard over the millennia. Except for the Fire Giant Surtur, Ymir was the oldest known being in the Ten Realms. It has been said that millennia ago, warm air from the realm of fire Muspelheim crossed a dimensional barrier into the location of the magical Well of Life. Enormous amounts of ice from Niffleheim, the realm of ice and cold, formed above the Well of Life. In time, the warm air from Muspelheim caused the ice over the Well to transform into the living, sentient Ymir. Another being appeared from the ice, the enchanted cow Audumbla. Audumbla fed off the ice itself, and Ymir subsisted on the milk Audumbla produced. left|thumb ===Early years=== During a battle between the Ice Giants and the Asgardians, the young god Odin and his brothers Vili and Ve slew Ymir. In return, the Ice Giants and the Giants of Jotunheim declared war on the Asgardians for slaying their progenitor. Meanwhile, Ymir's blood was used to produce a wine of which Lerad managed to acquire many barrels. After Ymir succeeded in regenerating himself, Odin created a chasm containing an interdimensional nexus through which Ymir's army plunged into Muspelheim, where the native demons took the Giants prisoners. Odin then entrapped Ymir himself within a circle of flame within a volcanic area. ===Hyborian Age=== At some point before 10,000 BC, humans began to worship Ymir and his first daughter as deities. Among these humans were the Vanir of Hyborian Vanaheim people whose members would include Ulysses Bloodstone. Conan the Barbarian once met Atali, who claimed to be a daughter of Ymir, and set a trap for Conan. Conan was able to kill Atali's Frost Giant brothers, before he was struck. ===Modern Age=== Centuries later in modern day, the Midgard Vanir captured Iceman of the first class of X-Men in order to use his powers and him as a sacrifice to bring back Ymir, for them to rule a frozen Earth. Helped by Donald Blake, the X-Men were able to save Iceman, but Vanir's minion Ulf the Ice Troll served as sacrifice in his place, awakening Ymir. This one rejected the Vanir, while Blake turned into Thor. While the Odinson was able to stop him and exile him to the nether realm of Asgard, Ymir could now easily breach the gaps between worlds, becoming a more pressing matter for Earth's safety. He was later fully returned by Bellos of the Bold Eye who murdered the Frost Giants children in his village and used their blood to fully complete the ritual before he himself was killed by Utand and the rest of the villagers. A member of the mystical cult called the Sons of Satannish used the so-called Spell of Fire and Ice to bring both Ymir and Surtur to Earth, where they began wreaking havoc. While Ymir attacked Wakanda, Surtur wreaked havoc in Antarctica. Earth's Sorcerer Supreme, Doctor Stephen Strange, used the Crystal of Conquest, which contained part of the mystical power of the demons known as Satannish and Mephisto, to transport Surtur and Ymir magically into each other's presence at the very instant they were lashing out with their weapons. Ymir and Surtur thus struck each other's weapons, creating a mystical "implosion" in which each being temporarily cancelled out the powers of the other, and each was returned to his home dimension, Surtur to Muspelheim and Ymir to Niffleheim. thumb|200px|Surtur vs. Ymir Ymir escaped again and started working with the Frost Giants, led by Bjorn the White, and Storm Giants, led by Grim Graybeard. He launched an attack on Asgard. However he was stopped by Thor and his brother Vidar. After Ymir reached freedom once again, Surtur disguised himself as Odin as part of a plan to destroy Asgard and told Heimdall that Ragnarök was upon them and Ymir had to be be stopped. After warriors were sent to fight Ymir, Odin transformed into Surtur and fought Ymir. With Surtur and Ymir locked in combat, Thor retrieved the Twilight Sword from the Sea of Eternal Night. After Thor lit the Twilight Sword in the Eternal Flame, Odin's control over Surtur started to vanish. Surtur and Ymir fought over the Twilight Sword, and while they were distracted, Thor transported them both into the Sea of Eternal Night, where they would be frozen for all time. They remained there for many years. Many years later, under unrevealed circumstances, Ymir resurfaced on Manhattan in Midgard, and used his powers to merge Midgard with Niffleheim. When the New Avengers and the Avengers tried to confront him, Ymir banished them to the in-between of the merged

weapons: Ymir carries an enormous, ice-covered club, which he uses as a weapon. Possibly the club is entirely composed of ice.
weaknesses: Ymir is vulnerable to extreme high temperature. It would caused him to melt down.

When Excalibur visited, he updated Captain Britain and Meggan's entries to take into account their new uniforms, but saw that something was wrong with Shadowcat, who was actually Rachel Summers in disguise. He summoned the Master Archivist, blaming him for inputting the entry wrong. The Archivist grew angry, and attacked the Inspector. Excalibur snuck away while they were fighting.

immortal man.name: Immortal Man
immortal man.species: Last of the Apex, a species from an artificial, self-contained environment
immortal man.origin: The Immortal Man was one of the two surviving members of the Apex, an advanced species that had inhabited Tabula Rasa for millions of years. When a temporal anomaly isolated the region from the outside world, he attempted to escape the enclosed environment, but his experiment went awry, leaving him trapped between dimensions for approximately 65 million years. During that time, the Apex civilization perished, with the local ecosystem feeding upon their dormant bodies. Freed when the temporal anomaly collapsed, the Immortal Man returned to Tabula Rasa and discovered that his people were gone. Grief-stricken, he blamed the primitive life forms that had evolved in their absence and began attacking them, while the X-Men mistakenly became involved in the conflict. Believing that the Celestial energies accumulated within the Palace of Slumber could restore the Apex by transforming the creatures that had fed upon their remains, he attempted to harness them for his plan. The Immortal Man confronted the X-Men when they reached the palace, refusing to abandon his efforts despite their warnings that doing so would destroy every living thing in Tabula Rasa. His former companion, known as the Savage, tried to reason with him and ultimately sabotaged the process by releasing the accumulated Celestial energies into the surrounding land. Enraged by what he regarded as a betrayal, the Immortal Man vowed to destroy the entire region and its remaining life, then teleported away, leaving the X-Men and the Savage to face the consequences of his actions.

imogen.name: Imogen
imogen.origin: Imogen was a traveling thief who spent at a least 100 years in search for a mysterious artifact called the Crucible. She met with the slaver called Broker and purchased Century from him. Imogen needed Century's teleportation ability to travel to the dimension the Crucible was located in. Century was forced to teleport Imogen and her crew to the dimension. After arriving, however, they were immediately overwhelmed by Azimuth, the guardian of the Crucible. Azimuth told Imogen and her crew that they weren't welcome there. When Azimuth was distracted while talking with Century, Imogen struck her with a magical attack, knocking her into a coma. Imogen then grabbed the Crucible and fled while Century and her crew were fighting off the Broker. She hasn't been seen since.
abilities: Imogen is apparently able to recruit unlikely allies to her cause, indicating great charisma (or perhaps mind control).

imp in the violin.name: Imp in the Violin
imp in the violin.origin: The Imp in the Violin is a member of a race of tiny, mystical creatures called Imps. During the 16th Century, the Imp resided with a colony of his people, living in secret in the home of a violin maker in Italy. When the violin maker made a new Amati violin, the Imp fell in love with it and claimed it before any of his fellows could and lived in it for many centuries and grew to appreciate classical music. By the year 1948 the violin was owned by American classical violinist Vincent Varl in New York City. Varl was well established for his mastery of classical music, but his popularity was soon starting to fade due to Jazz music becoming the next in thing. It was recommended by his manager, girlfriend and encouraged by his friend Captain America to start doing Jazz performances in order to boost his popularity. Although having reservations at first, Vincent decided to go ahead with the move. However, when he first set to practice new Jazz numbers, the music deeply offended the Imp who made his presence known and vowed to ruin his performances should he play Jazz music on the Amati. Vincent tried to explain things to his girlfriend, who dismissed it as nerves. When he told Captain America, the hero took him to a psychiatrist who dismissed the Imp as a hallucination caused by Varl's subconscious. With no other choice, Vincent put on his show and the Imp attempted to ruin his music. However, the Imp soon became enamoured by the chorus girls dancing and soon found an appreciation for Jazz music, also his meddling also created a unique sound that made Vincent a instant hit. The Imp and Vincent soon made peace and they were both last seen putting on a show with Vincent playing Jazz on his Amati and the Imp dancing with the girls to his hearts delight.
powers: The Imp appeared to have the ability to alter or distort the music that came out of the Amati violin that he lived in. He was also very long lived if not immortal, having been alive as early as the 16th Century.

impala.name: Impala
impala.origin: ===Early Life=== Impala was born and raised in the African nation of Zambia. She is a mercenary, but follows a strict honor code. She was said to have previously battled members of The Supremacists, a team of superhumans based in South Africa, and a hero known as the Coal Tiger. ===Femizons=== Impala turned up as a member of Superia's all-female army of supervillains and mercenaries, the Femizons. Aboard Superia's yacht, Impala participated in a pageant of Femizons showing off their abilities. Impala befriended her fellow mercenaries Asp and Black Mamba and helped them search for their friend Diamondback, who had been thrown overboard. ===B.A.D. Girls, Inc.=== After the Superia affair, Impala came to the aid of Asp and Black Mamba again, when they were attacked by several other former Femizons, who were seeking to claim a bounty on their heads. For a time afterwards, Impala was a member of Asp and Black Mamba's mercenary group BAD Girls, Inc.. With her new teammates, Impala clashed with the Avenger Sersi when they attempted to steal a Serpent Saucer from the headquarters of the Serpent Society. She has, however, rarely appeared recently.
weapons: Impala carried a stock of foot-long javelins that she could throw with deadly accuracy.

inali redpath.name: Inali Redpath
inali redpath.origin: Inali Redpath and Captain America once rescued 182 people from a prison camp in the Balkans. Years later, he was sent to investigate a secret S.H.I.E.L.D. human engineering facility in Florida called the Smokehouse. He was shot and mortally wounded while trying to subdue the rogue scientists working there. As he lay dying, he called upon the Anasazi god Haokah for help. With help from his grandfather, Haokah heard Inali's prayers and transfer Inali to a cloned body while also turning him into a receptacle for his power. Because Haokah's power always fatally harmed Inali' powers, he relied a facility on his grandfather's reservation to constantly create cloned bodies to transfer his consciousness to in order to survive. After killing the rogue S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Barricade, Inali confronted Cap and told him that he planned to use the power of Haokah to retake the United States for the Native America. Inali then drugged Cap with an hallucinatory concoction. He later summoned a mighty hurricane above Miami, causing the death of 147 victims. Cap confronted Inali with help from Thor. Haokah left Inali to confront Thor personally, leaving Inali powerless and was quickly defeated by Cap. After S.H.I.E.L.D. destroyed the facility that created his cloned bodies, Inali could no longer survive Haokah's possession and eventually vanished.

incinerator jones.name: Incinerator Jones
incinerator jones.origin: Cousin Bob was the leader of the Jones Boys. In 8162, late on a payment to the National Union of Retired Sports Experts (N.U.R.S.E.), he led his team in a raid on the base of the Evil Dead, counting on their weakened state after a recent encounter with Dragon's Claws. He and his son tried to stay behind to let the others take the brunt of the fighting. However, his team was wiped out by Death's Head, hired by Death Nell to protect the base, and by Dragon's Claws who soon joined the fray at the beckon of N.U.R.S.E. Incinerator Jones was engaged in a fight with Mercy Connaught. In his last moments, he was trying to tell her that Dragon's Claws are being used by N.U.R.S.E. to collect debts in their racketeering business. But Mercy finished his life without paying much attention.
